source.text: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις παραγίνεται Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστὴς κηρύσσων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ λέγων· Μετανοεῖτε, ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

records.literal_gloss: In then the days those comes John the Baptist preaching in the wilderness of the Judea \v 2 and saying, Repent, has come near for the kingdom of the heavens.

en.L: In those days John the Baptist comes, preaching in the wilderness of Judea \v 2 and saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has come near."
en.B: In those days John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness of Judea with a message. \v 2 "Repent," he proclaimed, "because the kingdom of heaven has come near."
en.R: At that time John the Baptist came to the desert land of Judea and preached to the people. \v 2 He said, "Turn away from your sins and come back to God, because the kingdom of heaven is coming near."

es.L: Y en aquellos días se presenta Juan el Bautista, proclamando en el desierto de Judea \v 2 y diciendo: «{{plural_you:Arrepiéntanse|Arrepentíos}}, porque se ha acercado el reino de los cielos».
es.B: En aquellos días apareció Juan el Bautista en el desierto de Judea con un mensaje. \v 2 «{{plural_you:Arrepiéntanse|Arrepentíos}}», proclamaba, «porque el reino de los cielos ya se ha acercado».
es.R: En ese tiempo, Juan el Bautista llegó a la región desierta de Judea y le predicaba a la gente. \v 2 Decía: «{{plural_you:Apártense de sus|Apartaos de vuestros}} pecados y {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a Dios, porque el reino de los cielos se está acercando».

fr.L: Or en ces jours-là paraît Jean le Baptiste, proclamant dans le désert de Judée \v 2 et disant : « Repentez-vous, car le royaume des cieux s’est approché. »
fr.B: En ces jours-là, Jean le Baptiste parut dans le désert de Judée avec un message. \v 2 « Repentez-vous, proclamait-il, car le royaume des cieux s’est approché. »
fr.R: À cette époque, Jean le Baptiste est venu dans le désert de Judée, et il s’est mis à parler aux gens. \v 2 Il disait : « Détournez-vous de vos péchés et revenez à Dieu, car le royaume des cieux est tout proche. »

sw.L: Basi katika siku hizo Yohana Mbatizaji anajitokeza, akitangaza katika nyika ya Uyahudi \v 2 akisema, "Tubuni, kwa sababu ufalme wa mbinguni umekaribia."
sw.B: Katika siku hizo Yohana Mbatizaji alitokea katika nyika ya Uyahudi akiwa na ujumbe. \v 2 Alitangaza, "Tubuni, kwa sababu ufalme wa mbinguni umekaribia."
sw.R: Wakati huo Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja katika eneo la jangwa la Uyahudi, akawahubiria watu. \v 2 Alisema, "Acheni dhambi zenu mrudi kwa Mungu, kwa sababu ufalme wa mbinguni unakaribia."

ko.L: 그 날들에 세례자 요한이 유대 광야에 나타나 선포하며 \v 2 말한다. "회개하여라. 천국이 가까이 왔기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그 무렵에 세례자 요한이 유대 광야에 나타나서 이렇게 선포했다. \v 2 "회개하여라. 천국이 가까이 왔다."
ko.R: 그 무렵 세례자 요한이 유대 지방의 빈 들에 와서 사람들에게 하나님의 말씀을 전했다. \v 2 요한이 말했다. "죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오너라. 천국이 가까이 오고 있다."

vi.L: Trong những ngày ấy, Giăng Báp-tít xuất hiện, rao giảng trong đồng hoang xứ Giu-đê \v 2 và nói: "Hãy ăn năn, vì vương quốc thiên đàng đã đến gần."
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, Giăng Báp-tít xuất hiện trong đồng hoang xứ Giu-đê và rao giảng: \v 2 "Hãy ăn năn, vì vương quốc thiên đàng đã đến gần."
vi.R: Lúc ấy, Giăng Báp-tít đến vùng sa mạc thuộc xứ Giu-đê và giảng cho dân chúng. \v 2 Ông nói: "Hãy từ bỏ tội lỗi, quay về với Đức Chúa Trời, vì vương quốc thiên đàng đang đến gần."

pt.L: Naqueles dias chega João Batista, pregando no deserto da Judeia \v 2 e dizendo: "Arrependam-se, pois o Reino dos céus se aproximou."
pt.B: Naqueles dias, João Batista apareceu no deserto da Judeia com uma mensagem. \v 2 "Arrependam-se", proclamava ele, "porque o Reino dos céus está próximo."
pt.R: Naquele tempo, João Batista foi para a região deserta da Judeia e pregava ao povo. \v 2 Ele dizia: "Abandonem os seus pecados e voltem para Deus, porque o Reino dos céus está chegando."

am.L: በዚያም ወራት መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ በይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ እየሰበከ ይመጣል፤ \v 2 እንዲህም ይላል፦ «ንስሓ ግቡ፤ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለችና።»
am.B: በዚያ ዘመን መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ በይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ መልእክት ይዞ ተገለጠ። \v 2 «ንስሓ ግቡ» እያለ ያውጅ ነበር፤ «መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለች።»
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ ወደ ይሁዳ በረሃ መጥቶ ለሕዝቡ ይሰብክ ነበር። \v 2 እንዲህም አለ፦ «ኃጢአታችሁን ትታችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለሱ፤ የሰማይ መንግሥት እየቀረበች ነውና።»

ru.L: В те же дни приходит Иоанн Креститель, проповедуя в пустыне Иудеи \v 2 и говоря: «Покайтесь, ведь приблизилось Царство Небесное.»
ru.B: В те дни в Иудейской пустыне появился Иоанн Креститель со своей вестью. \v 2 «Покайтесь», — призывал он, — «потому что Царство Небесное приблизилось.»
ru.R: В то время Иоанн Креститель пришёл в пустынную землю Иудеи и стал проповедовать людям. \v 2 Он говорил: «Оставьте свои грехи и вернитесь к Богу, потому что Небесное Царство уже близко.»

hi.L: उन दिनों में यूहन्ना बपतिस्मा देनेवाला आता है, यहूदिया के निर्जन प्रदेश में प्रचार करते हुए \v 2 और यह कहते हुए, "मन फिराओ, क्योंकि स्वर्ग का राज्य निकट आ पहुँचा है।"
hi.B: उन दिनों में यूहन्ना बपतिस्मा देनेवाला एक संदेश लेकर यहूदिया के निर्जन प्रदेश में प्रकट हुआ। \v 2 "मन फिराओ," वह प्रचार करता था, "क्योंकि स्वर्ग का राज्य पास आ गया है।"
hi.R: उस समय यूहन्ना बपतिस्मा देनेवाला यहूदिया के सुनसान इलाक़े में आया और लोगों को प्रचार करने लगा। \v 2 उसने कहा, "अपने पापों से मुड़ो और परमेश्वर की ओर लौट आओ, क्योंकि स्वर्ग का राज्य पास आ रहा है।"

uk.L: А в ті дні приходить Іван Хреститель, проповідуючи в Юдейській пустелі \v 2 і кажучи: «Покайтеся, бо наблизилося Царство Небесне.»
uk.B: У ті дні в Юдейській пустелі зʼявився Іван Хреститель зі своєю звісткою. \v 2 «Покайтеся», — проголошував він, — «бо наблизилося Царство Небесне.»
uk.R: У той час Іван Хреститель прийшов у пустельний край Юдеї і проповідував людям. \v 2 Він казав: «Відверніться від своїх гріхів і поверніться до Бога, бо Небесне Царство вже близько.»

ja.L: そのころ、洗礼者ヨハネが現れ、ユダヤの荒れ野で宣べ伝えて、\v 2 言う。「悔い改めなさい。天の国は近づいたからである。」
ja.B: そのころ、洗礼者ヨハネがユダヤの荒れ野に現れて、教えを宣べ伝えた。\v 2 「悔い改めなさい」とヨハネは呼びかけた。「天の国が近づいたのだから。」
ja.R: そのころ、洗礼者ヨハネがユダヤの荒れ野にやって来て、人々に教えを伝えました。\v 2 ヨハネは言いました。「心を入れ替えて神に立ち返りなさい。天の国が近づいている。」

id.L: Pada hari-hari itu Yohanes Pembaptis datang, berkhotbah di padang gurun Yudea \v 2 dan berkata, "Bertobatlah, sebab Kerajaan Surga sudah dekat."
id.B: Pada masa itu Yohanes Pembaptis tampil di padang gurun Yudea dengan sebuah pesan. \v 2 "Bertobatlah," serunya, "sebab Kerajaan Surga sudah dekat."
id.R: Pada waktu itu Yohanes Pembaptis datang ke padang gurun di daerah Yudea. Dia memberitakan pesan Allah. \v 2 Katanya, "Bertobatlah! Tinggalkan dosa-dosamu dan kembalilah kepada Allah, sebab Allah sudah dekat untuk memerintah sebagai Raja."

zh.L: 在那些日子，施洗约翰来到，在犹太的旷野宣讲，\v 2 说：“你们要悔改，因为天国已经临近了。”
zh.B: 那时，施洗约翰出现在犹太的旷野，传讲信息。\v 2 “你们要悔改，”他宣告说，“因为天国已经临近了。”
zh.R: 那时，施洗约翰来到犹太的荒野，向人们传讲。\v 2 他说：“你们要离开罪，回到{{god_term:神|上帝}}身边，因为天国快要来到了。”

fa.L: در آن روزها یحیای تعمیددهنده می‌آید و در بیابان یهودیه موعظه می‌کند \v 2 و می‌گوید: «توبه کنید، زیرا ملکوت آسمان‌ها نزدیک شده است.»
fa.B: در آن روزها یحیای تعمیددهنده با پیامی در بیابان یهودیه ظاهر شد. \v 2 «توبه کنید،» او اعلام می‌کرد، «زیرا ملکوت آسمان نزدیک شده است.»
fa.R: در آن زمان یحیای تعمیددهنده به بیابان یهودیه آمد و برای مردم موعظه کرد. \v 2 او می‌گفت: «از گناهانتان دست بکشید و به سوی خدا بازگردید، زیرا پادشاهی آسمان نزدیک می‌شود.»

decisions.choice: in those days: a loose link, years after chapter 2
alternatives: the same time as the move to Nazareth
decisions.reason: The phrase is a common way to open a new part of the story. Jesus is now a grown man (3:13).

decisions.choice: repent: change one's mind and way of life, turning back to God
decisions.reason: The word means a change of mind. In the prophets' call to Israel to return to God, it is a turning of the whole life, which John asks to see in deeds (3:8).

decisions.choice: the kingdom of heaven: God's rule, the kingdom of God
alternatives: a place in heaven where people go after death
decisions.reason: Matthew nearly always says "kingdom of heaven" where Mark and Luke say "kingdom of God" (compare 4:17 with Mark 1:15), as Jews often spoke of heaven out of reverence for God's name. It is God's reign coming to earth, as in the prayer "your kingdom come" (6:10).

decisions.choice: has come near: it is close at hand, already pressing in
decisions.reason: The perfect tense says the kingdom has drawn near and is now close. Jesus will announce it in the same words (4:17).

decisions.choice: the kingdom of heaven (B, R); the kingdom of the heavens (L)
decisions.reason: "Heavens" is plural in Greek, following Hebrew. Balanced and Readable say "heaven", as English does, and keep Matthew's phrase, which the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: turn away from your sins and come back to God; the desert land
decisions.reason: Readable says what repenting means, and calls the wilderness by a word new readers know. It was dry, empty country, not sand desert.

decisions.choice: el reino de los cielos
decisions.reason: Matthew's own phrase for the kingdom of God (meaning decision m3), used through the book. Spanish keeps the plural "cielos" at every level, where English keeps it only at Literal, because "el reino de los cielos" is the natural Spanish phrase.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Arrepiéntanse|Arrepentíos}}
decisions.reason: John speaks to the crowds, so every plural "you" takes the reader setting: "ustedes" (Latin America, the default) or "vosotros" (Spain). English has no such choice. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); historic presents kept as presents at Literal ("paraît", "arrive", "laisse")
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 1-2 and the other Gospels: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken. Speech keeps its own tenses at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: le royaume des cieux at every level (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet. English Balanced and Readable say "heaven", but French keeps the plural "des cieux", which is the set phrase in French and is not hard for new readers; the meaning note says it is God's rule (m3). "Royaume" as in Mark's and Luke's "royaume de Dieu".

decisions.choice: repentez-vous, la repentance (L, B); détournez-vous de vos péchés et revenez à Dieu (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and Mark: Readable says what repenting means (m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: ufalme wa mbinguni
decisions.reason: Matthew's own phrase for the kingdom of God (meaning decision m3), used through the book. "Ufalme wa mbinguni" (the kingdom in heaven) is the natural Swahili phrase at every level; Swahili does not mark the Greek plural "heavens".

decisions.choice: Tubuni (L, B); Acheni dhambi zenu mrudi kwa Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: "Kutubu" is the word for repentance through Matthew (meaning decision m2). Readable spells out the turning from sin and back to God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "천국" at every level, through Matthew
decisions.reason: "천국" is the word Korean readers know for Matthew's phrase, and in Korean it means the reign and realm of heaven, not only a place after death; the meaning decision says it is God's rule. Literal does not spell out "the kingdom of the heavens" ("하늘들의 나라"), so that the term reads the same at every level; Matthew's "heaven", where Mark and Luke say "God", stays visible.

decisions.choice: "회개하여라" (L, B); "죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오너라" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark: "회개" is the established word; Readable says what it means, turning from sin back to God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "세례자 요한" at every level; "광야" (L, B), "빈 들" (R)
decisions.reason: Matthew uses the noun "the Baptist" as a title, so every level says "세례자", as Mark's Balanced and Readable do. The wilderness words follow Mark.

decisions.choice: historic present kept in Literal ("말한다"), through Matthew 3; past in Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As docs/korean-style.md section 3 asks for the historic present; one note for the passage.

decisions.choice: "vương quốc thiên đàng" for the kingdom of heaven, at every level and through Matthew
decisions.reason: Mark's "kingdom of God" is "vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời" in Vietnamese, so Matthew's phrase keeps "vương quốc" for God's rule as king, with the familiar "thiên đàng" for "the heavens". Literal does not copy the Greek plural, which is a Hebrew way of saying "heaven". "Nước Trời" is the Catholic form, and "nước" now reads first as "country". A reviewer should check that "thiên đàng" is not heard only as the place of the dead; the meaning decision says the phrase means God's rule.

decisions.choice: "Hãy ăn năn" (L, B); "Hãy từ bỏ tội lỗi, quay về với Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:4 and 1:15: "ăn năn" is the Protestant word for repentance; Readable unfolds it as the English Readable does. "Đã đến gần" (L, B) and "đang đến gần" (R) also follow Mark 1:15. The same in 4:17.

decisions.choice: historic present kept at Literal by leaving out "đã" ("xuất hiện"; also 3:13, 3:15 and the temptation in 4:5-11)
decisions.reason: As the style guide says, Literal keeps Matthew's present-tense storytelling by not adding "đã"; Balanced and Readable tell it as plain narrative.

decisions.choice: arrependam-se (L, B); abandonem os seus pecados e voltem para Deus (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 6). "Arrepender-se" is the word Brazilian readers know; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does. "Converter-se" is used in Brazil for changing religion, which is not John's point.

decisions.choice: o deserto (L, B); a região deserta (R)
decisions.reason: "Deserto" in Portuguese means empty, uninhabited land as well as sand desert, so it fits the dry country of Judea; Readable says "região deserta", which keeps that sense.

decisions.choice: መንግሥተ ሰማያት (L, B); የሰማይ መንግሥት (the kingdom of heaven, R)
decisions.reason: "መንግሥተ ሰማያት" is the established church form of Matthew's phrase, and its plural keeps the Greek "heavens". It is Ge'ez in shape, so Readable uses the everyday Amharic "የሰማይ መንግሥት". Matthew's own wording is kept rather than replaced by "the kingdom of God", which means the same thing (see the meaning decision). This holds through the book.

decisions.choice: ንስሓ ግቡ (repent, L, B); ኃጢአታችሁን ትታችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለሱ (leave your sins and come back to God, R)
decisions.reason: "ንስሓ ግቡ" is the living word for turning back to God; "ተጸጸቱ" says only that one feels regret. Readable spells out the change of life, as the English Readable does, because the church phrase can sound like a rite of confession.

decisions.choice: "स्वर्ग का राज्य" at every level
decisions.reason: The book's key term for the kingdom of heaven. Hindi "स्वर्ग" serves for the Greek plural "heavens" as well, so Literal needs no separate form.

decisions.choice: "मन फिराओ" (L, B); "अपने पापों से मुड़ो और परमेश्वर की ओर लौट आओ" (R)
decisions.reason: "मन फिराना" says both the change of mind and the turning of life; "पश्चाताप" means only regret. Readable spells out the turn, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "आता है" (L); "प्रकट हुआ", "आया" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek's historic present.

decisions.choice: "निर्जन प्रदेश" (L, B); "सुनसान इलाक़ा" (R) for the wilderness, through the book
decisions.reason: The wilderness was dry, empty country away from towns, not forest; "जंगल" would suggest woodland to a modern reader. The same words stand at 3:3, 4:1, 11:7 and 24:26.

decisions.choice: 'Царство Небесное' (L, B); 'Небесное Царство' (R)
decisions.reason: The term this translation uses for God's rule throughout Matthew. Literal and Balanced keep the familiar word order; Readable puts the adjective first, as everyday Russian does.

decisions.choice: 'Покайтесь' (L, B); 'Оставьте свои грехи и вернитесь к Богу' (R)
decisions.reason: 'Покаяние' is the living church word and stays at Literal and Balanced. Readable says what it means: a turning away from sin and back to God.

decisions.choice: 'приходит' (L); 'появился', 'пришёл' (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek historic present, as Russian storytelling also can; Balanced and Readable tell it in the past.

decisions.choice: "Царство Небесне" (L, B); "Небесне Царство" (R)
decisions.reason: "Царство Небесне", with the adjective after the noun, is the form Ukrainian readers know; Readable puts it in everyday word order. The Greek plural "heavens" is carried by the adjective at every level.

decisions.choice: "Відверніться від своїх гріхів і поверніться до Бога" (R) for "Покайтеся"
decisions.reason: Readable spells out both sides of repentance, the turning away and the turning back to God, for readers who do not know the church word.

decisions.choice: "天の国" at every level, through the book
decisions.reason: Matthew's own phrase is kept, as the English does (m3); it means God's rule, and "神の国" stays for the places where Matthew writes "kingdom of God". The Greek plural "heavens" is not shown.

decisions.choice: "悔い改めなさい" (L, B); "心を入れ替えて神に立ち返りなさい" (R)
decisions.reason: Repenting is a turning of the whole life back to God (m2). Readable says so in everyday words, as in Mark.

decisions.choice: present "現れ……言う" (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:13, Literal keeps Matthew's present tense of narration; Balanced and Readable narrate in the past.

decisions.choice: "Kerajaan Surga" (L, B); R says that God is near to reign as King
decisions.reason: "Kerajaan Surga" is the glossary term for Matthew's "kingdom of the heavens" at every level where the English keeps the phrase; Matthew's plural "heavens" is not kept, since Indonesian "surga" has no plural use. Readable explains it where the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Yohanes Pembaptis"; "bertobat"
decisions.reason: Glossary forms, for the whole of Matthew. Readable says what repentance is, as in Mark.

decisions.choice: "天国" at every level
decisions.reason: Matthew's "kingdom of the heavens" is God's rule, the kingdom of God. The glossary's "天国" is the church's shared term and is kept at every level through Matthew; the plural "heavens" is not shown, as Chinese does not mark it.

decisions.choice: "悔改" (L, B); "离开罪，回到{{god_term:神|上帝}}身边" (R)
decisions.reason: "悔改" is the key term; Readable says what it means, a turn from sin back to God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "{{god_term:神|上帝}}"
decisions.reason: Every word naming the one God is written as the god_term setting: "神" by default, "上帝" for readers who choose it.

decisions.choice: "ملکوت آسمان‌ها" (Literal); "ملکوت آسمان" (Balanced); "پادشاهی آسمان" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Matthew's kingdom of heaven; the brief's ملکوت at Literal and Balanced and پادشاهی at Readable.

decisions.choice: "توبه کنید" (Literal, Balanced); "از گناهانتان دست بکشید و به سوی خدا بازگردید" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Repentance is turning from sin to God.

decisions.choice: "می‌آید" (Literal); "ظاهر شد", "آمد" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Matthew's historic present.

decisions.choice: "بیابان" at every level, through the book
decisions.reason: As in Mark and Luke.

source.text: οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ῥηθεὶς διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος· Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ· Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: This for is the [one] spoken through Isaiah the prophet saying, Voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of Lord, straight make the paths of him.

en.L: For this is the one spoken of through Isaiah the prophet, saying, \q "[The] voice of one crying out in the wilderness: \q 'Prepare the way of [the] Lord, \q make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} paths straight.'"
en.B: John is the one the prophet Isaiah spoke of when he said, \q "A voice is calling out in the wilderness: \q 'Prepare the way of the Lord, \q straighten the roads {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will travel.'"
en.R: The prophet Isaiah spoke about John when he said, \q "Someone is shouting in the desert: \q 'Get the road ready for the Lord! \q Make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} paths straight!'"

es.L: Porque este es el [que fue] anunciado por medio de Isaías el profeta, que dice: \q «Voz de uno que clama en el desierto: \q “{{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} el camino del Señor, \q {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} rectas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sendas”».
es.B: Juan es la persona a la que se refería el profeta Isaías cuando dijo: \q «Una voz grita en el desierto: \q “{{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} el camino del Señor, \q {{plural_you:enderecen|enderezad}} los caminos por donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pasará”».
es.R: El profeta Isaías habló de Juan cuando dijo: \q «Alguien grita en el desierto: \q “¡{{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} el camino para el Señor! \q ¡{{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} rectas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sendas!”».

fr.L: Car c’est lui dont il a été parlé par l’intermédiaire d’Isaïe le prophète, disant : \q « Voix de quelqu’un qui crie dans le désert : \q “Préparez le chemin du Seigneur, \q rendez droits {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} sentiers.” »
fr.B: C’est de Jean qu’avait parlé le prophète Isaïe, quand il disait : \q « Une voix crie dans le désert : \q “Préparez le chemin du Seigneur, \q aplanissez les routes où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} passera.” »
fr.R: Le prophète Isaïe parlait de Jean quand il a dit : \q « Quelqu’un crie dans le désert : \q “Préparez la route pour le Seigneur ! \q Rendez {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chemins bien droits !” »

sw.L: Kwa sababu huyu ndiye yule aliyetajwa kupitia Isaya nabii, akisema, \q "Sauti ya mtu anayepaza sauti nyikani: \q 'Iandaeni njia ya Bwana, \q yafanyeni mapito {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yanyooke.'"
sw.B: Yohana ndiye ambaye nabii Isaya alimtaja aliposema, \q "Sauti inaita nyikani: \q 'Mwandalieni Bwana njia, \q nyoosheni barabara atakazopita.'"
sw.R: Nabii Isaya alizungumza kuhusu Yohana aliposema, \q "Mtu anapiga kelele jangwani: \q 'Mtengenezeeni Bwana njia! \q Nyoosheni mapito {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}!'"

ko.L: 이 사람은 이사야 예언자를 통하여 말씀하신 바로 그 사람이다. [그 말씀은] 이러하다. \q "광야에서 외치는 사람의 소리[가 들린다]. \q '주님의 길을 준비하여라. \q 그분의 오솔길들을 곧게 만들어라.'"
ko.B: 요한은 이사야 예언자가 말한 바로 그 사람이다. 이사야는 이렇게 말했다. \q "광야에서 외치는 사람의 소리가 있다. \q '주님의 길을 준비하여라. \q 그분이 다니실 길을 곧게 내어라.'"
ko.R: 이사야 예언자가 요한에 대해 이렇게 말했다. \q "빈 들에서 누군가가 외치고 있다. \q '주님께서 오실 길을 준비하여라! \q 그분이 다니실 길을 곧게 만들어라!'"

vi.L: Vì chính ông là người đã được nói đến qua nhà tiên tri Ê-sai, rằng: \q "Tiếng của [người] kêu lên trong đồng hoang: \q 'Hãy dọn đường của Chúa, \q hãy làm cho thẳng các lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'"
vi.B: Giăng chính là người mà nhà tiên tri Ê-sai đã nói đến: \q "Có tiếng kêu lên trong đồng hoang: \q 'Hãy dọn đường cho Chúa, \q hãy sửa cho thẳng những lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đi.'"
vi.R: Nhà tiên tri Ê-sai đã nói về Giăng như sau: \q "Có người đang kêu lớn trong sa mạc: \q 'Hãy dọn đường sẵn cho Chúa! \q Hãy làm thẳng các lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi!'"

pt.L: Pois este é aquele de quem foi falado por meio de Isaías, o profeta, dizendo: \q "Voz de quem clama no deserto: \q 'Preparem o caminho do Senhor, \q tornem retas as veredas {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.'"
pt.B: João é aquele de quem o profeta Isaías falou quando disse: \q "Uma voz clama no deserto: \q 'Preparem o caminho do Senhor, \q endireitem as estradas por onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai passar.'"
pt.R: O profeta Isaías falou sobre João quando disse: \q "Alguém está gritando no deserto: \q 'Preparem a estrada para o Senhor! \q Façam caminhos retos para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}!'"

am.L: ይህ በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ በኩል የተነገረለት ነውና፤ እንዲህ ሲል፦ \q «በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ [ሰው] ድምፅ፦ \q “የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ፤ \q ጥርጊያዎቹንም ቀና አድርጉ።”»
am.B: ዮሐንስ ነቢዩ ኢሳይያስ እንዲህ ብሎ የተናገረለት ሰው ነው፦ \q «በምድረ በዳ እንዲህ ብሎ የሚጣራ ድምፅ አለ፦ \q “የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ፤ \q የሚጓዝባቸውንም መንገዶች አቅኑ።”»
am.R: ነቢዩ ኢሳይያስ ስለ ዮሐንስ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናግሮ ነበር፦ \q «አንድ ሰው በበረሃ እንዲህ እያለ ይጮኻል፦ \q “ለጌታ መንገዱን አዘጋጁ! \q የሚሄድባቸውን መንገዶች ቀጥ አድርጉ!”»

ru.L: Ведь это тот, о ком сказано через Исаию, пророка, говорящего: \q «Голос вопиющего в пустыне: \q “Приготовьте путь Господа, \q прямыми делайте тропы {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.”»
ru.B: Иоанн — тот, о ком говорил пророк Исаия: \q «Голос зовёт в пустыне: “Приготовьте путь Господу, \q выпрямите дороги, \q по которым {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} пойдёт.”»
ru.R: Пророк Исаия говорил об Иоанне: \q «Кто-то кричит в пустыне: \q “Приготовьте дорогу для Господа! \q Сделайте прямыми {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} тропы!”»

hi.L: क्योंकि यह वही है जिसके विषय में यशायाह भविष्यद्वक्ता के द्वारा कहा गया था, कि \q "निर्जन प्रदेश में पुकारनेवाले की आवाज़: \q 'प्रभु का रास्ता तैयार करो, \q उनके मार्ग सीधे बनाओ।'"
hi.B: यूहन्ना वही है जिसके विषय में यशायाह भविष्यद्वक्ता ने कहा था, \q "निर्जन प्रदेश में एक आवाज़ पुकार रही है: \q 'प्रभु का मार्ग तैयार करो, \q जिन रास्तों से वे आएँगे उन्हें सीधा करो।'"
hi.R: यशायाह नबी ने यूहन्ना के बारे में यह कहा था, \q "सुनसान इलाक़े में कोई ज़ोर से पुकार रहा है: \q 'प्रभु के लिए रास्ता तैयार करो! \q उनके रास्ते सीधे करो!'"

uk.L: Бо це той, про кого сказано через пророка Ісаю, який говорить: \q «Голос того, хто кличе в пустелі: \q “Приготуйте дорогу Господа, \q прямими робіть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} стежки.”»
uk.B: Іван — той, про кого говорив пророк Ісая: \q «Голос кличе в пустелі: \q “Приготуйте дорогу Господеві, \q вирівняйте шляхи, якими {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} піде.”»
uk.R: Пророк Ісая говорив про Івана, коли сказав: \q «Хтось кличе в пустелі: \q “Приготуйте дорогу для Господа! \q Зробіть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} стежки прямими!”»

ja.L: この人こそ、預言者イザヤを通して言われた人である。[預言者は]こう言っている。 \q 「荒れ野で叫ぶ者の声[がする]。 \q 『主の道を備えなさい。 \q その小道をまっすぐにしなさい。』」
ja.B: ヨハネこそ、預言者イザヤがこう言ったときに語っていた人である。 \q 「荒れ野で呼びかける声がする。 \q 『主の道を備えなさい。 \q 主がお通りになる道をまっすぐにしなさい。』」
ja.R: 預言者イザヤは、ヨハネのことをこう言っていました。 \q 「荒れ野で、ある人が叫んでいる。 \q 『主のために道を準備しなさい。 \q 主が通られる道をまっすぐにしなさい。』」

id.L: Sebab inilah dia yang disebut melalui Nabi Yesaya, yang berkata, \q "Suara orang yang berseru-seru di padang gurun: \q 'Persiapkanlah jalan Tuhan, \q luruskanlah jalan-jalan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.'"
id.B: Yohanes adalah orang yang dibicarakan oleh Nabi Yesaya ketika ia berkata, \q "Ada suara yang berseru di padang gurun: \q 'Persiapkanlah jalan bagi Tuhan, \q luruskanlah jalan yang akan dilalui-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.'"
id.R: Yohanes inilah orang yang dimaksud Nabi Yesaya ketika dia menulis, \q "Ada orang yang berseru di padang gurun: \q 'Siapkan jalan untuk Tuhan! \q Luruskan jalan yang akan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} lalui!'"

zh.L: 这人就是借着先知以赛亚所说的那一位，[经上]说： \q “一个人在旷野呼喊的声音： \q ‘你们要为主准备道路， \q 使{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的小路笔直。’”
zh.B: 约翰就是先知以赛亚所说的那一位，以赛亚说： \q “有声音在旷野呼喊： \q ‘要为主准备道路， \q 把{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要走的路取直。’”
zh.R: 先知以赛亚说的就是约翰，他说： \q “有人在荒野里大声喊叫： \q ‘为主把路准备好！ \q 让{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}走的路笔直！’”

fa.L: زیرا این همان است که به زبان اشعیای نبی دربارهٔ او گفته شد، که می‌گوید: \q «صدای کسی که در بیابان ندا می‌کند: \q “راه خداوند را آماده کنید، \q مسیرهای او را راست کنید.”»
fa.B: یحیی همان است که اشعیای نبی دربارهٔ او گفت: \q «صدایی در بیابان ندا می‌کند: \q “راه خداوند را آماده کنید، \q جاده‌ها را برای او راست سازید.”»
fa.R: اشعیای نبی دربارهٔ یحیی سخن گفت، آن‌گاه که گفت: \q «کسی در بیابان فریاد می‌زند: \q “راه را برای خداوند آماده کنید! \q مسیر را برای او صاف کنید!”»

decisions.choice: Isaiah 40:3: the voice that prepares the Lord's road home
decisions.reason: In Isaiah 40 a voice calls for a road to be made ready for God, who is coming to bring his people back from exile. Matthew quotes the Greek Old Testament, which joins "in the wilderness" to the voice; the Hebrew joins it to "prepare". Either way John fits: he preaches in the wilderness.

decisions.choice: the Lord: God in Isaiah; the one John prepares for is Jesus
alternatives: God alone, with no thought of Jesus
decisions.reason: In Isaiah the Lord is God, whose name stands in the Hebrew. John prepares the way for the one coming after him (3:11), who is Jesus (3:13-17). Matthew lets the words for God's coming describe Jesus's coming.

decisions.choice: this is the one: Matthew's comment, not John's
decisions.reason: "For" introduces the narrator's explanation of who John is.

decisions.choice: his paths (L, R); the roads he will travel (B), with deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: no span, as for a pronoun for God in Isaiah
decisions.reason: The pronoun is for the Lord, whom Matthew identifies with Jesus, so it takes the usual span.

decisions.choice: John (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name John for clarity.

decisions.choice: barabara atakazopita, with no span
decisions.reason: The English Balanced "the roads he will travel" has a span on "he". Swahili carries "he" in the verb prefix of "atakazopita", which cannot take a capital, so Balanced has no span here; Literal and Readable keep it on "yake".

decisions.choice: the quotation of Isaiah 40:3 worded as in the Korean Mark 1:3 at each level
decisions.reason: The Greek of the quotation is the same in both Gospels, so the Korean is too. "그분" and "주님" carry the respect the English deity_pronoun span gives.

decisions.choice: the words of Isaiah 40:3 as in the Vietnamese Mark 1:3
decisions.reason: The Greek of the quotation is the same as in Mark, so the Vietnamese reads alike, as synoptic parallels should; "đồng hoang" (L, B) and "sa mạc" (R) are kept for the wilderness through chapter 4.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting for capitalised pronouns has nothing to change; pronouns for the Lord, for Jesus and for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span
alternatives: a span offering a capitalised pronoun
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi. The honorific third person carries respect for God and Jesus at every level.

decisions.choice: "भविष्यद्वक्ता" (L, B); "नबी" (R)
decisions.reason: The book's word for prophet; Readable uses the everyday "नबी".

decisions.choice: 'пророк'
decisions.reason: The word this translation uses for a prophet at every level, as the style guide settles.

decisions.choice: "預言者イザヤを通して言われた" with "[預言者は]こう言っている" (L), as in the fulfilment formula
decisions.reason: The Greek uses the words of Matthew's fulfilment formula ("spoken through the prophet, saying") without the verb fulfil, so Literal keeps the same Japanese words.

decisions.choice: "主がお通りになる道" (B); "主が通られる道" (R)
decisions.reason: The Lord whose road is prepared is God in Isaiah and Jesus in Matthew's telling (m2), so Balanced and Readable use a respect form for his coming, as Mark 1:3 does in Japanese.

decisions.choice: "Tuhan" in the quotation of Isaiah 40:3
decisions.reason: The Greek has kyrios, so Indonesian writes "Tuhan", as the style guide sets for New Testament quotations; the Hebrew has the divine name there.
Isaiah 40:3 has the divine name in Hebrew, but Matthew's Greek has kyrios, and Matthew applies it to Jesus; so Chinese writes "主", as the English writes "Lord" (style guide section 4).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; Isaiah's words as in Mark 1:3 and Luke 3:4
decisions.reason: Persian pronouns have no capital letter, and the gospels quote the same lines.

decisions.choice: "اشعیای نبی" at every level
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:2 and Luke 3:4.

source.text: αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Ἰωάννης εἶχεν τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τριχῶν καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ, ἡ δὲ τροφὴ ἦν αὐτοῦ ἀκρίδες καὶ μέλι ἄγριον.

records.literal_gloss: He then the John had the garment of him from hairs of camel and a belt leathern around the waist of him, the then food was of him locusts and honey wild.

en.L: Now John himself had his clothing of camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.
en.B: John himself dressed in clothing woven from camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
en.R: John wore clothes made from camel hair, with a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts, a kind of grasshopper, and honey that he found in the wild.

es.L: Y Juan mismo tenía su ropa de pelo de camello y un cinturón de cuero en torno a su cintura, y su alimento eran langostas y miel silvestre.
es.B: Juan se vestía con ropa tejida de pelo de camello y llevaba un cinturón de cuero a la cintura; comía langostas y miel silvestre.
es.R: Juan llevaba ropa hecha de pelo de camello, con un cinturón de cuero en la cintura. Comía langostas, que son una especie de saltamontes, y miel que encontraba en el campo.

fr.L: Or Jean lui-même avait son vêtement de poils de chameau et une ceinture de cuir autour de ses reins, et sa nourriture était des sauterelles et du miel sauvage.
fr.B: Jean portait un vêtement tissé de poils de chameau, avec une ceinture de cuir autour de la taille, et il se nourrissait de sauterelles et de miel sauvage.
fr.R: Jean portait des vêtements faits en poils de chameau, avec une ceinture de cuir autour de la taille. Il mangeait des sauterelles et du miel qu’il trouvait dans la nature.

sw.L: Naye Yohana mwenyewe alikuwa na nguo yake ya nywele za ngamia, na mkanda wa ngozi kuzunguka kiuno chake, na chakula alichokula kilikuwa nzige na asali ya porini.
sw.B: Yohana mwenyewe alivaa nguo iliyofumwa kwa nywele za ngamia, akiwa na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni, naye alikula nzige na asali ya porini.
sw.R: Yohana alivaa nguo zilizotengenezwa kwa manyoya ya ngamia, na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni. Alikula nzige, aina ya panzi, na asali aliyoipata porini.

ko.L: 이 요한은 낙타 털로 된 옷을 입고 허리에 가죽 띠를 [둘렀으며], 그의 음식은 메뚜기와 들꿀이었다.
ko.B: 요한은 낙타 털로 짠 옷을 입고 허리에 가죽 띠를 둘렀으며, 메뚜기와 들꿀을 먹었다.
ko.R: 요한은 낙타 털로 만든 옷을 입고, 허리에는 가죽 띠를 매고 있었다. 그는 메뚜기와, 들에서 찾은 꿀을 먹었다.

vi.L: Còn chính Giăng thì mặc áo bằng lông lạc đà và thắt dây lưng bằng da quanh hông, và thức ăn của ông là châu chấu và mật ong rừng.
vi.B: Chính Giăng mặc áo bằng lông lạc đà, thắt lưng bằng dây da, và ông ăn châu chấu với mật ong rừng.
vi.R: Giăng mặc áo làm bằng lông lạc đà, có dây da thắt ngang lưng. Ông ăn châu chấu và mật ong tìm được ngoài hoang dã.

pt.L: E o próprio João tinha a sua roupa de pelos de camelo e um cinto de couro em volta da cintura, e o seu alimento eram gafanhotos e mel silvestre.
pt.B: O próprio João usava uma roupa tecida de pelos de camelo, com um cinto de couro na cintura, e comia gafanhotos e mel silvestre.
pt.R: João vestia roupas feitas de pelo de camelo, com um cinto de couro na cintura. Ele comia gafanhotos e mel que encontrava no mato.

am.L: ዮሐንስም ራሱ የግመል ጠጉር ልብስ ነበረው፤ በወገቡም ዙሪያ የቆዳ ቀበቶ [ነበረው]፤ ምግቡም አንበጣና የዱር ማር ነበረ።
am.B: ዮሐንስ ራሱ ከግመል ጠጉር የተሠራ ልብስ ይለብስ ነበር፤ በወገቡም የቆዳ ቀበቶ ይታጠቅ ነበር፤ አንበጣና የዱር ማርም ይመገብ ነበር።
am.R: ዮሐንስ ከግመል ጠጉር የተሠራ ልብስ ይለብስ ነበር፤ በወገቡም የቆዳ ቀበቶ ያስር ነበር። የሚበላውም አንበጣ ነበረ፤ አንበጣ እንደ ፌንጣ ያለ ነፍሳት ነው። በዱር ያገኘውንም ማር ይበላ ነበር።

ru.L: Сам же Иоанн имел свою одежду из верблюжьего волоса и кожаный пояс вокруг своих бёдер, а пищей его были саранча и дикий мёд.
ru.B: Сам Иоанн носил одежду из верблюжьей шерсти и подпоясывался кожаным поясом, а ел он саранчу и дикий мёд.
ru.R: Иоанн носил одежду из верблюжьей шерсти и кожаный пояс. Он ел саранчу, похожую на больших кузнечиков, и мёд диких пчёл.

hi.L: और यूहन्ना स्वयं ऊँट के बालों का वस्त्र पहने रहता था और अपनी कमर पर चमड़े का पटुका, और उसका भोजन टिड्डियाँ और जंगली मधु था।
hi.B: यूहन्ना स्वयं ऊँट के बालों से बुने वस्त्र पहनता था, कमर पर चमड़े का पटुका बाँधता था, और टिड्डियाँ और जंगली मधु खाता था।
hi.R: यूहन्ना ऊँट के बालों से बने कपड़े पहनता था, और उसकी कमर पर चमड़े की पेटी होती थी। वह टिड्डियाँ, जो एक तरह के कीड़े हैं, और जंगल में मिलनेवाला शहद खाता था।

uk.L: А сам Іван мав свій одяг з верблюжого волосу і шкіряний пояс довкола свого стану, а їжею його були сарана і дикий мед.
uk.B: Сам Іван носив одяг із верблюжої вовни і шкіряний пояс на стані, а їв сарану й дикий мед.
uk.R: Іван носив одяг з верблюжої вовни, підперезаний шкіряним поясом. Він їв сарану — це такі великі коники — і мед диких бджіл.

ja.L: さて、ヨハネ自身は、らくだの毛の衣を着、腰には革の帯を締めていた。そして彼の食べ物は、いなごと野の蜜であった。
ja.B: ヨハネは、らくだの毛で織った衣を着て、腰に革の帯を締め、いなごと野の蜜を食べていた。
ja.R: ヨハネは、らくだの毛で作った服を着て、腰に革の帯を締めていました。食べ物は、いなごと、野で見つけた蜂蜜でした。

id.L: Yohanes sendiri memakai pakaian dari bulu unta dan ikat pinggang kulit pada pinggangnya, dan makanannya adalah belalang dan madu hutan.
id.B: Yohanes sendiri memakai pakaian yang ditenun dari bulu unta, dengan ikat pinggang kulit pada pinggangnya, dan ia makan belalang dan madu hutan.
id.R: Yohanes memakai baju dari bulu unta dan ikat pinggang dari kulit. Makanannya adalah belalang dan madu dari hutan.

zh.L: 约翰自己有用骆驼毛做的衣服，腰上系着一条皮带；他的食物是蝗虫和野地的蜂蜜。
zh.B: 约翰本人穿的是骆驼毛织成的衣服，腰间系着皮带，他以蝗虫和野蜂蜜为食。
zh.R: 约翰穿着用骆驼毛做的衣服，腰上系着皮带。他吃蝗虫，那是一种蚱蜢，也吃在野外找到的蜂蜜。

fa.L: و خود یحیی جامه‌اش از پشم شتر بود و کمربندی چرمی بر کمر داشت، و خوراکش ملخ و عسل صحرایی بود.
fa.B: یحیی خود جامه‌ای بافته از پشم شتر بر تن داشت و کمربندی چرمی بر کمر، و ملخ و عسل صحرایی می‌خورد.
fa.R: یحیی لباسی از پشم شتر می‌پوشید و کمربندی چرمی به کمر می‌بست. او ملخ، که نوعی حشره است، و عسلی را که در صحرا پیدا می‌کرد می‌خورد.

decisions.choice: camel's hair and a leather belt: the dress of Elijah
decisions.reason: Elijah was known as a hairy man with a leather belt around his waist (2 Kings 1:8). Malachi promised that Elijah would come before the day of the Lord (Malachi 4:5), and Jesus later says that John is the Elijah who was to come (11:14; 17:12-13).

decisions.choice: locusts and wild honey: food found in the wilderness
decisions.reason: The law allows locusts as food (Leviticus 11:22). Wild honey was taken from wild bees. John lives on what the wilderness provides, apart from towns.

decisions.choice: locusts, a kind of grasshopper
decisions.reason: Readable says what locusts are.

decisions.choice: des sauterelles, with no explanation at Readable
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:6: English Readable explains "locusts" as a kind of grasshopper. French "sauterelle" is already the everyday name of that insect, so Readable needs no gloss.

decisions.choice: "châu chấu" with no explanation (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:6: the English Readable explains "locusts", but "châu chấu" is an everyday Vietnamese word, so no explanation is needed.

decisions.choice: gafanhotos, with no explanation
decisions.reason: The English Readable explains "locusts" as a kind of grasshopper. Portuguese "gafanhoto" already names both, and every reader knows it, so nothing needs adding.

decisions.choice: 'саранча'
decisions.reason: 'Акриды' is the old church word and is not understood today; 'саранча' names the insect.

decisions.choice: "いなご" with no explanation (R)
decisions.reason: Japanese readers know "いなご" as a common insect, one that is even eaten in parts of Japan, so Readable needs no gloss, unlike the English; Mark 1:6 does the same.

source.text: τότε ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία καὶ πᾶσα ἡ περίχωρος τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Then were going out to him Jerusalem and all the Judea and all the region around the Jordan, \v 6 and were being baptized in the Jordan river by him confessing the sins of them.

en.L: Then Jerusalem and all Judea and all the region around the Jordan were going out to him, \v 6 and they were being baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.
en.B: Crowds kept coming out to him from Jerusalem, from all over Judea, and from all the country along the Jordan. \v 6 They confessed their sins, and he baptized them in the Jordan River.
en.R: People from Jerusalem, from all over Judea, and from all the land near the Jordan River came out to John. \v 6 They told how they had done wrong, and John baptized them in the Jordan River.

es.L: Entonces salían hacia él Jerusalén y toda Judea y toda la comarca del Jordán, \v 6 y eran bautizados en el río Jordán por él, mientras confesaban sus pecados.
es.B: Venían a él multitudes de Jerusalén, de toda Judea y de toda la región del Jordán. \v 6 Confesaban sus pecados, y él los bautizaba en el río Jordán.
es.R: Gente de Jerusalén, de toda Judea y de toda la tierra cercana al río Jordán salía a ver a Juan. \v 6 Contaban el mal que habían hecho, y Juan los bautizaba en el río Jordán.

fr.L: Alors sortaient vers lui Jérusalem, et toute la Judée, et toute la région autour du Jourdain, \v 6 et ils étaient baptisés par lui dans le fleuve Jourdain, confessant leurs péchés.
fr.B: Des foules venaient à lui sans cesse, de Jérusalem, de toute la Judée et de toute la région qui borde le Jourdain. \v 6 Elles confessaient leurs péchés, et il les baptisait dans le Jourdain.
fr.R: Des gens venaient voir Jean : ils venaient de Jérusalem, de toute la Judée et de toute la région près du fleuve Jourdain. \v 6 Ils disaient le mal qu’ils avaient fait, et Jean les baptisait dans le fleuve Jourdain.

sw.L: Ndipo Yerusalemu na Uyahudi wote na eneo lote linalozunguka Yordani walikuwa wakimwendea, \v 6 nao walikuwa wakibatizwa naye katika mto Yordani, wakiziungama dhambi zao.
sw.B: Umati wa watu uliendelea kumwendea kutoka Yerusalemu, kutoka kila sehemu ya Uyahudi na kutoka nchi yote iliyo kando ya Yordani. \v 6 Wakaungama dhambi zao, naye akawabatiza katika mto Yordani.
sw.R: Watu kutoka Yerusalemu, kutoka Uyahudi kote, na kutoka nchi yote iliyo karibu na mto Yordani walikuja kwa Yohana. \v 6 Walieleza makosa waliyofanya, naye Yohana akawabatiza katika mto Yordani.

ko.L: 그때 예루살렘과 온 유대와 요단 주변의 온 지역이 그에게로 나가고 있었고, \v 6 자기들의 죄를 고백하며 요단강에서 그에게 세례를 받고 있었다.
ko.B: 그때 예루살렘과 온 유대와 요단강 주변 온 지역에서 사람들이 요한에게로 줄지어 나왔다. \v 6 그들은 자기 죄를 고백했고, 요한은 요단강에서 그들에게 세례를 주었다.
ko.R: 예루살렘과 유대 온 지역과 요단강 근처 온 땅에서 사람들이 요한에게 나왔다. \v 6 그들은 자기가 저지른 잘못을 털어놓았고, 요한은 요단강에서 그들에게 세례를 주었다.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Giê-ru-sa-lem, cả xứ Giu-đê và cả vùng chung quanh sông Giô-đanh đều kéo ra với ông, \v 6 và họ được ông làm báp-têm trong sông Giô-đanh, xưng tội mình.
vi.B: Bấy giờ dân chúng từ Giê-ru-sa-lem, từ khắp xứ Giu-đê và cả vùng dọc theo sông Giô-đanh lũ lượt kéo ra với ông. \v 6 Họ xưng tội mình và được ông làm báp-têm dưới sông Giô-đanh.
vi.R: Người ta từ thành Giê-ru-sa-lem, từ khắp miền Giu-đê và từ cả vùng gần sông Giô-đanh kéo đến với Giăng. \v 6 Họ thú nhận những điều sai trái mình đã làm, và Giăng làm báp-têm cho họ dưới sông Giô-đanh.

pt.L: Então saíam até ele Jerusalém, e toda a Judeia, e toda a região ao redor do Jordão, \v 6 e eram batizados por ele no rio Jordão, confessando os seus pecados.
pt.B: Multidões vinham até ele, de Jerusalém, de toda a Judeia e de toda a região ao longo do Jordão. \v 6 Confessavam os seus pecados, e ele os batizava no rio Jordão.
pt.R: Gente de Jerusalém, de toda a Judeia e de todas as terras perto do rio Jordão ia até João. \v 6 As pessoas contavam as coisas erradas que tinham feito, e João as batizava no rio Jordão.

am.L: ከዚያም ኢየሩሳሌም፣ ይሁዳ ሁሉ፣ በዮርዳኖስ አካባቢ ያለውም ምድር ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ይወጣ ነበር፤ \v 6 በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝም ኃጢአታቸውን እየተናዘዙ በእርሱ ይጠመቁ ነበር።
am.B: ከኢየሩሳሌም፣ ከይሁዳ ሁሉና በዮርዳኖስ ዳር ካለው አገር ሁሉ ብዙ ሕዝብ ወደ እርሱ ይጎርፍ ነበር። \v 6 ኃጢአታቸውንም ይናዘዙ ነበር፤ እርሱም በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ያጠምቃቸው ነበር።
am.R: ከኢየሩሳሌም፣ ከይሁዳ ሁሉና በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ አጠገብ ካለው ምድር ሁሉ ሰዎች ወደ ዮሐንስ መጡ። \v 6 ያደረጉትን ክፉ ነገር በግልጥ ተናገሩ፤ ዮሐንስም በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ አጠመቃቸው።

ru.L: Тогда выходили к нему Иерусалим, и вся Иудея, и вся окрестность Иордана, \v 6 и крестились от него в реке Иордан, исповедуя свои грехи.
ru.B: К нему шли толпы из Иерусалима, со всей Иудеи и со всех мест вдоль Иордана. \v 6 Люди исповедовали свои грехи, и он крестил их в реке Иордан.
ru.R: К Иоанну приходили люди из Иерусалима, со всей Иудеи и со всей земли возле реки Иордан. \v 6 Они рассказывали, в чём согрешили, и Иоанн крестил их в реке Иордан.

hi.L: तब यरूशलेम और सारा यहूदिया और यरदन के आस-पास का सारा इलाक़ा उसके पास निकलकर आता था, \v 6 और वे अपने पापों को मानते हुए यरदन नदी में उससे बपतिस्मा लेते थे।
hi.B: यरूशलेम से, सारे यहूदिया से और यरदन के आस-पास के सारे प्रदेश से भीड़ की भीड़ उसके पास आती रही। \v 6 वे अपने पाप मान लेते थे, और वह उन्हें यरदन नदी में बपतिस्मा देता था।
hi.R: यरूशलेम से, सारे यहूदिया से और यरदन नदी के पास के सारे इलाक़े से लोग यूहन्ना के पास आए। \v 6 उन्होंने बताया कि उन्होंने क्या-क्या ग़लत किया है, और यूहन्ना ने उन्हें यरदन नदी में बपतिस्मा दिया।

uk.L: Тоді виходили до нього Єрусалим, і вся Юдея, і вся околиця Йордану, \v 6 і хрестилися від нього в річці Йордан, визнаючи свої гріхи.
uk.B: До нього раз у раз виходили люди з Єрусалима, з усієї Юдеї та з усієї округи над Йорданом. \v 6 Вони визнавали свої гріхи, а він хрестив їх у річці Йордан.
uk.R: До Івана приходили люди з Єрусалима, з усієї Юдеї та з усіх місць біля річки Йордан. \v 6 Вони розповідали, що зробили погано, і Іван хрестив їх у річці Йордан.

ja.L: そのとき、エルサレムとユダヤ全土とヨルダン川周辺の地方全体が、彼のもとへ出て来ていた。\v 6 そして自分たちの罪を告白しながら、ヨルダン川で彼から洗礼を受けていた。
ja.B: エルサレムから、ユダヤ全土から、またヨルダン川沿いの地方一帯から、人々が次々とヨハネのもとに出て来た。\v 6 彼らは自分の罪を告白し、ヨルダン川でヨハネから洗礼を受けた。
ja.R: エルサレムや、ユダヤのあちこちや、ヨルダン川の近くの地方から、人々がヨハネのところに出て来ました。\v 6 人々は、自分がしてきた悪いことを言い表しました。そしてヨルダン川で、ヨハネから洗礼を受けました。

id.L: Lalu Yerusalem dan seluruh Yudea dan seluruh daerah sekitar Yordan datang kepadanya, \v 6 dan mereka dibaptis olehnya di sungai Yordan, sambil mengaku dosa-dosa mereka.
id.B: Orang banyak terus berdatangan kepadanya dari Yerusalem, dari seluruh Yudea, dan dari seluruh daerah sepanjang sungai Yordan. \v 6 Mereka mengaku dosa-dosa mereka, dan ia membaptis mereka di sungai Yordan.
id.R: Banyak orang dari Yerusalem, dari seluruh daerah Yudea, dan dari daerah sekitar sungai Yordan datang kepada Yohanes. \v 6 Mereka mengakui dosa-dosa mereka, lalu Yohanes membaptis mereka di sungai Yordan.

zh.L: 那时耶路撒冷、整个犹太，和约旦河周围的整个地区，都陆续出来到他那里，\v 6 并且在约旦河中被他施洗，同时承认自己的罪。
zh.B: 许多人从耶路撒冷、从犹太各地、从约旦河沿岸一带不断来到他那里。\v 6 他们承认自己的罪，约翰就在约旦河里为他们施洗。
zh.R: 从耶路撒冷、犹太各地和约旦河附近的地区，有很多人出来到约翰那里。\v 6 他们说出自己做过的错事，约翰就在约旦河里给他们施洗。

fa.L: آن‌گاه اورشلیم و تمام یهودیه و همهٔ نواحی اطراف اردن نزد او بیرون می‌رفتند، \v 6 و به گناهان خود اعتراف کرده، در رود اردن از او تعمید می‌گرفتند.
fa.B: جماعت‌ها از اورشلیم، از سراسر یهودیه و از همهٔ سرزمین کنار اردن پیوسته نزد او بیرون می‌آمدند. \v 6 به گناهان خود اعتراف می‌کردند، و او ایشان را در رود اردن تعمید می‌داد.
fa.R: مردم از اورشلیم، از سراسر یهودیه و از همهٔ سرزمین نزدیک رود اردن نزد یحیی آمدند. \v 6 آنان کارهای بدی را که کرده بودند به خدا می‌گفتند، و یحیی ایشان را در رود اردن تعمید می‌داد.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem and all Judea: the people of those places, in great numbers
decisions.reason: The places stand for their people, and "all" stresses how many came. The imperfect verbs say they kept coming.

decisions.choice: baptized: dipped or washed in water
decisions.reason: The verb means to dip or immerse. Jews washed in water to become clean for worship. John's washing, given once and joined to confessing sins, marked a turning back to God ahead of the coming judgment.

decisions.choice: confessing their sins: saying openly what they had done wrong
alternatives: admitting sin only in their hearts
decisions.reason: The verb means to acknowledge out loud. They named their sins as they came to be baptized.

decisions.choice: crowds kept coming (B); people ... came (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the people instead of the places.

decisions.choice: "хрестити", "хреститися" at every level
decisions.reason: "Хрестити" is the Ukrainian word for the act, and readers recognise John's baptism in it. Nothing in this passage turns on the washing itself, so Literal does not need "занурювати".

decisions.choice: the places as subject (L); "人々が" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The places stand for their people (m1). Literal keeps the Greek figure; Balanced and Readable name the people, as the English does.

source.text: Ἰδὼν δὲ πολλοὺς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων ἐρχομένους ἐπὶ τὸ βάπτισμα αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς;

records.literal_gloss: Having seen then many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to the baptism of him he said to them, Offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

en.L: But seeing many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, "Offspring of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
en.B: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for baptism, he said to them, "You family of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming wrath?
en.R: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. When John saw them, he said to them, "You are like a family of poisonous snakes! Who told you that you could escape from God's anger that is coming?

es.L: Pero viendo a muchos de los fariseos y saduceos que venían a su bautismo, les dijo: «¡Crías de víboras! ¿Quién {{plural_you:les|os}} advirtió que {{plural_you:huyeran|huyerais}} de la ira venidera?
es.B: Pero cuando Juan vio que muchos fariseos y saduceos venían a bautizarse, les dijo: «¡Familia de serpientes! ¿Quién {{plural_you:les|os}} advirtió que {{plural_you:huyeran|huyerais}} de la ira que viene?
es.R: Muchos fariseos y saduceos también vinieron para que Juan los bautizara. Cuando Juan los vio, les dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} como una familia de serpientes venenosas! ¿Quién {{plural_you:les|os}} dijo que {{plural_you:podían|podíais}} escapar de la ira de Dios que se acerca?

fr.L: Mais voyant beaucoup de Pharisiens et de Sadducéens venir à son baptême, il leur dit : « Progéniture de vipères ! Qui vous a avertis de fuir la colère à venir ?
fr.B: Mais quand Jean vit beaucoup de Pharisiens et de Sadducéens venir se faire baptiser, il leur dit : « Enfants de serpents ! Qui vous a avertis de fuir la colère qui vient ?
fr.R: Beaucoup de Pharisiens et de Sadducéens sont venus, eux aussi, pour se faire baptiser. Quand Jean les a vus, il leur a dit : « Vous êtes comme une famille de serpents venimeux ! Qui vous a dit que vous pourriez échapper à la colère de Dieu qui va venir ?

sw.L: Lakini akiisha kuona wengi wa Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wakija kwa ajili ya ubatizo wake, alisema nao, "Ninyi uzao wa nyoka wenye sumu! Nani amewaelekeza kukimbia mbali na ghadhabu ijayo?
sw.B: Lakini Yohana alipowaona Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wengi wakija kubatizwa, aliwaambia, "Ninyi jamaa ya nyoka! Ni nani aliyewaonya mkimbie ghadhabu inayokuja?
sw.R: Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wengi pia walikuja ili wabatizwe. Yohana alipowaona, aliwaambia, "Ninyi ni kama jamaa ya nyoka wenye sumu! Ni nani aliyewaambia kwamba mnaweza kuiepuka hasira ya Mungu inayokuja?

ko.L: 그러나 그는 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들 가운데 많은 이가 자기의 세례에 오는 것을 보고 그들에게 말하였다. "독사들의 자식들아, 누가 너희에게 다가올 진노를 피하라고 일러 주었느냐?
ko.B: 요한은 많은 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들이 세례를 받으러 오는 것을 보고 그들에게 말했다. "독사의 족속들아! 다가오는 진노를 피하라고 누가 너희에게 일러 주더냐?
ko.R: 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들도 많이 세례를 받으러 왔다. 요한은 그들을 보고 말했다. "너희는 독 있는 뱀의 무리와 같다! 곧 닥쳐올 하나님의 진노를 피할 수 있다고 누가 너희에게 말해 주더냐?

vi.L: Nhưng thấy nhiều người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê đến [chịu] phép báp-têm của mình, ông nói với họ: "Hỡi dòng giống rắn lục! Ai đã chỉ cho các người trốn khỏi cơn thịnh nộ sắp đến?
vi.B: Nhưng khi Giăng thấy nhiều người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê đến để chịu báp-têm, ông nói với họ: "Hỡi nòi rắn độc! Ai đã cảnh báo các người trốn khỏi cơn thịnh nộ sắp đến?
vi.R: Cũng có nhiều người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê đến để chịu báp-têm. Khi Giăng thấy họ, ông nói với họ: "Các người như một bầy rắn độc! Ai bảo các người rằng các người có thể thoát khỏi cơn giận của Đức Chúa Trời sắp đến?

pt.L: Mas, vendo muitos dos fariseus e saduceus vindo ao batismo dele, disse-lhes: "Crias de víboras! Quem os avisou para fugir da ira que está por vir?
pt.B: Quando João viu muitos fariseus e saduceus vindo para ser batizados, disse a eles: "Ninhada de víboras! Quem os avisou para fugirem da ira que está para vir?
pt.R: Muitos fariseus e saduceus também vieram para ser batizados. Quando João os viu, ele disse: "Vocês são como uma família de cobras venenosas! Quem disse a vocês que podem escapar da ira de Deus que está chegando?

am.L: ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያንም ብዙዎች ወደ ጥምቀቱ ሲመጡ አይቶ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «የእፉኝት ዘሮች! ከሚመጣው ቁጣ እንድትሸሹ ማን አሳያችሁ?
am.B: ዮሐንስ ግን ብዙ ፈሪሳውያንና ሰዱቃውያን ለመጠመቅ ሲመጡ ባየ ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እናንተ የእባብ ዘሮች! ከሚመጣው ቁጣ እንድታመልጡ ማን አስጠነቀቃችሁ?
am.R: ብዙ ፈሪሳውያንና ሰዱቃውያንም ለመጠመቅ መጡ። ዮሐንስ ባያቸው ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እናንተ እንደ መርዛም እባብ ዘሮች ናችሁ! ከሚመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቁጣ ማምለጥ እንደምትችሉ ማን ነገራችሁ?

ru.L: Увидев же многих из фарисеев и саддукеев, идущих к его крещению, он сказал им: «Порождения гадюк! Кто указал вам бежать от грядущего гнева?
ru.B: Но когда Иоанн увидел, что многие фарисеи и саддукеи идут креститься, он сказал им: «Змеиное отродье! Кто надоумил вас бежать от грядущего гнева?
ru.R: Многие фарисеи и саддукеи тоже пришли креститься. Когда Иоанн увидел их, он сказал им: «Вы как выводок ядовитых змей! Кто сказал вам, что вы сможете спастись от Божьего гнева, который скоро придёт?

hi.L: पर फ़रीसियों और सदूकियों में से बहुतों को अपने बपतिस्मे के लिए आते देखकर उसने उनसे कहा, "हे साँपों के बच्चो! तुम्हें किसने चिताया कि आनेवाले क्रोध से भागो?
hi.B: पर जब यूहन्ना ने बहुत-से फ़रीसियों और सदूकियों को बपतिस्मा लेने आते देखा, तो उसने उनसे कहा, "हे साँपों के वंश! तुम्हें किसने चिताया कि आनेवाले क्रोध से भागो?
hi.R: बहुत-से फ़रीसी और सदूकी भी बपतिस्मा लेने आए। उन्हें देखकर यूहन्ना ने उनसे कहा, "तुम ज़हरीले साँपों के परिवार जैसे हो! तुम्हें किसने बताया कि तुम परमेश्वर के आनेवाले क्रोध से बच सकते हो?

uk.L: А побачивши, що багато фарисеїв і садукеїв приходять на його хрещення, він сказав їм: «Поріддя гадюче! Хто попередив вас утікати від прийдешнього гніву?
uk.B: Коли ж Іван побачив, що багато фарисеїв і садукеїв приходять хреститися, він сказав їм: «Гадюче поріддя! Хто вас попередив тікати від гніву, що надходить?
uk.R: Багато фарисеїв і садукеїв також прийшли, щоб хреститися. Коли Іван побачив їх, він сказав їм: «Ви наче родина отруйних змій! Хто сказав вам, що ви зможете втекти від Божого гніву, який наближається?

ja.L: しかし、ファリサイ派とサドカイ派の人々が大勢、彼の洗礼[を受けるため]に来るのを見て、彼らに言った。「まむしの子孫たちよ、迫って来る怒りから逃れるようにと、だれがあなたがたに教えたのか？
ja.B: ヨハネは、ファリサイ派とサドカイ派の人々が大勢、洗礼を受けに来るのを見て、彼らに言った。「まむしの一族よ、迫り来る怒りから逃れられると、だれが教えたのか？
ja.R: ファリサイ派の人々やサドカイ派の人々も、大勢、洗礼を受けにやって来ました。ヨハネはその人たちを見て、言いました。「あなたたちは、毒へびの一族のようだ。やがて来る神の怒りから逃げられると、だれが教えたのか？

id.L: Tetapi ketika melihat banyak orang Farisi dan orang Saduki datang untuk dibaptis olehnya, ia berkata kepada mereka, "Hai keturunan ular beludak! Siapakah yang memperingatkan kalian untuk melarikan diri dari murka yang akan datang?
id.B: Tetapi ketika Yohanes melihat banyak orang Farisi dan orang Saduki datang untuk dibaptis, ia berkata kepada mereka, "Hai kalian keturunan ular! Siapa yang memperingatkan kalian untuk lari dari murka yang akan datang?
id.R: Yohanes melihat banyak orang Farisi dan orang Saduki datang untuk dibaptis. Dia berkata kepada mereka, "Kalian ini seperti ular berbisa! Kalian pikir kalian bisa lari dari hukuman Allah yang akan datang?

zh.L: 他看见许多法利赛人和撒都该人前来要受他的洗，就对他们说：“毒蛇的后代啊！谁提醒了你们，要躲开那即将来临的震怒？
zh.B: 约翰看见许多法利赛人和撒都该人来受洗，就对他们说：“你们这一窝毒蛇！谁警告你们要逃离那就要来的愤怒？
zh.R: 许多法利赛人和撒都该人也来受洗。约翰看见他们，就对他们说：“你们就像一窝毒蛇！谁告诉你们，你们能逃过{{god_term:神|上帝}}就要降下的怒气？

fa.L: اما چون دید که بسیاری از فریسیان و صدوقیان برای تعمید او می‌آیند، به ایشان گفت: «ای افعی‌زادگان، چه کسی به شما هشدار داد که از غضب آینده بگریزید؟
fa.B: اما چون یحیی دید که بسیاری از فریسیان و صدوقیان برای تعمید می‌آیند، به ایشان گفت: «ای مارزادگان! چه کسی به شما گفت که از خشمی که در راه است بگریزید؟
fa.R: بسیاری از فریسیان و صدوقیان نیز آمدند تا تعمید بگیرند. چون یحیی ایشان را دید، به ایشان گفت: «شما مانند خانواده‌ای از مارهای سمی هستید! چه کسی به شما گفت که می‌توانید از خشم آیندهٔ خدا فرار کنید؟

decisions.choice: Pharisees and Sadducees: two leading groups among the Jews
decisions.reason: The Pharisees were teachers and lay people devoted to keeping the law in detail. The Sadducees were mostly priests and wealthy families tied to the temple. The two groups often disagreed; Matthew names them together as Israel's leaders (16:1, 6).

decisions.choice: coming to his baptism: coming to be baptized
alternatives: coming to watch where he baptized
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean coming for baptism or coming to the place of baptism. John's answer, which questions why they would flee and asks for fruit, fits people who came to be baptized.

decisions.choice: offspring of vipers: people as dangerous and false as poisonous snakes
decisions.reason: Calling people children of something describes their nature. Jesus uses the same words for the Pharisees (12:34; 23:33).

decisions.choice: the coming wrath: God's judgment that is about to fall
decisions.reason: Wrath here is God's anger against sin at the judgment (1 Thessalonians 1:10). John sees it as near (3:10, 12).

decisions.choice: John
decisions.reason: A new paragraph begins here, so Balanced names John.

decisions.choice: you family of snakes (B); you are like a family of poisonous snakes (R)
decisions.reason: "Brood" and "viper" are less common words today. Readable makes the comparison plain.

decisions.choice: God's anger
decisions.reason: Readable says whose anger it is.

decisions.choice: Crías de víboras
decisions.reason: The Greek word is offspring, the young of an animal (meaning decision m3). "Crías" says that plainly; Balanced and Readable speak of a family of snakes, as the English does.

decisions.choice: les Pharisiens, les Sadducéens, capitalised (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet, John, Mark and Luke: the names of the groups take a capital, as in English.

decisions.choice: Progéniture de vipères (L); Enfants de serpents (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek "offspring". "Race de vipères" is the traditional wording, but "race" now sounds like ethnicity; Balanced says "Enfants de serpents", as Luke 3:7 and Matthew 12:34 do, which keeps the insult of the family picture (m3).

decisions.choice: "독사들의 자식들아" (L); "독사의 족속들아" (B); "너희는 독 있는 뱀의 무리와 같다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture word for word; Balanced uses "족속" (a breed or brood), as the English "family of snakes"; Readable turns the picture into a comparison (meaning decision on the idiom). John speaks in 해라체, as a prophet rebuking.

decisions.choice: "dòng giống rắn lục" (L); "nòi rắn độc" (B); "như một bầy rắn độc" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "offspring" and the kind of snake; Balanced uses "nòi", a sharp word for breed that keeps the insult; Readable makes the comparison plain, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: John speaks to the Pharisees and Sadducees as "các người"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:8: a prophet rebuking a crowd uses "các người", which is firm without being insulting in itself.

decisions.choice: Crias de víboras (L); Ninhada de víboras (B); Vocês são como uma família de cobras venenosas (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (12:34; 23:33). "Cria" and "ninhada" are the young of an animal, as the Greek word is; "raça" says something else in Portuguese today. Readable makes the comparison plain, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "साँपों के बच्चो" (L); "साँपों के वंश" (B); "ज़हरीले साँपों के परिवार जैसे" (R)
decisions.reason: The viper is a poisonous snake; Hindi "साँप" with "ज़हरीले" at Readable says what the picture means without a rare word for the species.

decisions.choice: 'Порождения гадюк' (L); 'Змеиное отродье' (B)
decisions.reason: 'Ехидна' now means a spiteful person or an Australian animal; 'гадюка' is the poisonous snake. Balanced uses the plain Russian insult.

decisions.choice: "Поріддя гадюче" (L); "Гадюче поріддя" (B)
decisions.reason: "Поріддя" says offspring with the contempt of the Greek; the saying keeps one form wherever it recurs in the Gospels. Literal keeps the Greek order.

decisions.choice: "まむしの子孫たちよ" (L); "まむしの一族よ" (B); "あなたたちは、毒へびの一族のようだ" (R), as in 12:34 and 23:33
decisions.reason: Calling people the offspring of vipers describes their nature (m3). Literal keeps the picture of offspring; Balanced says "family of vipers", and Readable makes the comparison plain, as the English does. Matthew uses the phrase again in 12:34 and 23:33 with the same wording.

decisions.choice: John speaks to the leaders in the plain style, with "あなたがた" (L, B) and "あなたたち" (R)
decisions.reason: John rebukes them as a prophet, so he speaks plainly and sharply, not politely.

decisions.choice: "orang Farisi", "orang Saduki"; "ular beludak" (L), "ular" (B), "ular berbisa" (R)
decisions.reason: Glossary forms. "beludak" is the KBBI word for a viper.

decisions.choice: "法利赛人", "撒都该人"
decisions.reason: The glossary's forms for the two groups, kept through Matthew.

decisions.choice: "毒蛇的后代啊" (L); "你们这一窝毒蛇" (B); "你们就像一窝毒蛇" (R)
decisions.reason: The insult calls them as dangerous and false as poisonous snakes. Literal says "offspring" plainly; Balanced uses the everyday picture of a nest of snakes; Readable makes it a comparison, as the English does. The same wording at each level in 12:34 and 23:33.

decisions.choice: "ای افعی‌زادگان" (Literal); "ای مارزادگان" (Balanced); "مانند خانواده‌ای از مارهای سمی" (Readable), with 3:7-10 worded as Luke 3:7-9
decisions.reason: The same warning in both gospels.

source.text: ποιήσατε οὖν καρπὸν ἄξιον τῆς μετανοίας καὶ μὴ δόξητε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς· Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ, λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ.

records.literal_gloss: Produce therefore fruit worthy of the repentance \v 9 and not think to say among yourselves, [As] father we have the Abraham, I say for to you that is able the God out of the stones these to raise up children to the Abraham.

en.L: Produce therefore fruit worthy of repentance, \v 9 and do not presume to say among yourselves, 'We have Abraham [as] father,' for I tell you that God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham.
en.B: So produce fruit that shows your repentance is real. \v 9 Do not imagine you can comfort yourselves by saying, 'Abraham is our father.' I tell you, God is able to make children for Abraham out of these stones.
en.R: Show by the way you live that you have really turned away from your sins. \v 9 Do not think, 'We are safe, because Abraham is our ancestor.' I tell you, God could make children for Abraham out of these stones.

es.L: {{plural_you:Produzcan|Producid}}, pues, fruto digno del arrepentimiento, \v 9 y no {{plural_you:presuman|presumáis}} de decir entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: “Tenemos a Abraham [por] padre”, porque {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que Dios es capaz de levantar de estas piedras hijos para Abraham.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:den|dad}} fruto que muestre que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} arrepentimiento es verdadero. \v 9 No {{plural_you:se imaginen|os imaginéis}} que {{plural_you:pueden tranquilizarse|podéis tranquilizaros}} diciendo: “Abraham es nuestro padre”. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que Dios puede sacar hijos para Abraham de estas piedras.
es.R: {{plural_you:Muestren|Mostrad}} con {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} manera de vivir que de verdad {{plural_you:se han apartado|os habéis apartado}} de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados. \v 9 No {{plural_you:piensen|penséis}}: “Estamos a salvo, porque Abraham es nuestro antepasado”. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que Dios podría hacer hijos para Abraham de estas piedras.

fr.L: Produisez donc du fruit digne de la repentance, \v 9 et ne pensez pas pouvoir dire en vous-mêmes : “Nous avons Abraham [pour] père”, car je vous dis que Dieu peut, de ces pierres, susciter des enfants à Abraham.
fr.B: Produisez donc un fruit qui montre que votre repentance est sincère. \v 9 Et n’allez pas vous rassurer en vous disant : “Abraham est notre père.” Car je vous le dis, de ces pierres que voici, Dieu peut faire naître des enfants à Abraham.
fr.R: Montrez par votre façon de vivre que vous vous êtes vraiment détournés de vos péchés. \v 9 Ne pensez pas : “Nous ne risquons rien, parce qu’Abraham est notre ancêtre.” Je vous le dis, Dieu pourrait faire de ces pierres des enfants pour Abraham.

sw.L: Basi toeni matunda yanayolingana na toba, \v 9 wala msidhani kusema ndani yenu, 'Tunaye Abrahamu [kama] baba,' kwa maana nawaambia kwamba Mungu ana uwezo wa kumwinulia Abrahamu watoto kutoka katika mawe haya.
sw.B: Basi zaeni matunda yanayoonyesha kwamba toba yenu ni ya kweli. \v 9 Msidhani mnaweza kujifariji kwa kusema, 'Abrahamu ni baba yetu.' Nawaambia, Mungu anaweza kumfanyia Abrahamu watoto kutoka katika mawe haya.
sw.R: Onyesheni kwa jinsi mnavyoishi kwamba kweli mmeacha dhambi zenu. \v 9 Msifikiri, 'Sisi tuko salama, kwa sababu Abrahamu ni babu yetu.' Nawaambia, Mungu angeweza kumfanyia Abrahamu watoto kutoka katika mawe haya.

ko.L: 그러므로 회개에 합당한 열매를 맺어라. \v 9 그리고 너희 속으로 '우리에게는 아버지 아브라함이 있다'라고 말할 생각을 하지 마라. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 하나님께서는 이 돌들로도 아브라함에게 자녀들을 일으키실 수 있다.
ko.B: 그러니 회개했다는 것을 보여 주는 열매를 맺어라. \v 9 그리고 '우리 조상은 아브라함이다'라고 속으로 말하며 안심할 생각은 하지 마라. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 하나님께서는 이 돌들로도 아브라함의 자녀를 만드실 수 있다.
ko.R: 너희가 정말로 죄에서 돌이켰다면, 그것을 사는 모습으로 보여라. \v 9 '우리는 아브라함의 자손이니까 괜찮다'라고 생각하지 마라. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 하나님께서는 이 돌들로도 아브라함의 자손을 만드실 수 있다.

vi.L: Vậy hãy kết quả xứng đáng với sự ăn năn, \v 9 và đừng tưởng [có thể] nói trong lòng rằng: 'Chúng ta có Áp-ra-ham là tổ phụ,' vì tôi nói với các người rằng Đức Chúa Trời có thể từ những hòn đá này dấy lên con cái cho Áp-ra-ham.
vi.B: Vậy hãy kết quả để chứng tỏ sự ăn năn của các người là thật. \v 9 Đừng tưởng có thể tự yên lòng mà nói: 'Áp-ra-ham là tổ phụ chúng ta.' Vì tôi nói cho các người biết, Đức Chúa Trời có thể biến những hòn đá này thành con cháu cho Áp-ra-ham.
vi.R: Hãy sống sao cho thấy các người thật sự đã từ bỏ tội lỗi. \v 9 Đừng nghĩ rằng: 'Chúng ta được an toàn, vì Áp-ra-ham là tổ tiên chúng ta.' Tôi nói cho các người biết, Đức Chúa Trời có thể biến những hòn đá này thành con cháu của Áp-ra-ham.

pt.L: Produzam, portanto, fruto digno do arrependimento \v 9 e não pensem em dizer a si mesmos: 'Temos Abraão [por] pai', pois eu lhes digo que Deus pode, destas pedras, levantar filhos para Abraão.
pt.B: Produzam, então, frutos que mostrem que o arrependimento de vocês é verdadeiro. \v 9 Não imaginem que podem se tranquilizar dizendo: 'Abraão é o nosso pai.' Eu lhes digo que Deus é capaz de fazer surgir filhos para Abraão destas pedras.
pt.R: Mostrem pelo jeito como vivem que vocês abandonaram mesmo os seus pecados. \v 9 Não pensem: 'Estamos seguros, porque Abraão é o nosso antepassado.' Eu digo a vocês: Deus poderia transformar estas pedras em filhos de Abraão.

am.L: ስለዚህ ለንስሓ የሚመጥን ፍሬ አፍሩ፤ \v 9 በራሳችሁም “አባት አብርሃም አለን” ለማለት አታስቡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆችን ማስነሣት እንደሚችል እነግራችኋለሁና።
am.B: ስለዚህ ንስሓችሁ እውነተኛ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ፍሬ አፍሩ። \v 9 “አባታችን አብርሃም ነው” እያላችሁ ራሳችሁን ለማጽናናት አታስቡ። እላችኋለሁ፣ እግዚአብሔር ከእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆችን ማስገኘት ይችላል።
am.R: ከኃጢአታችሁ በእውነት መመለሳችሁን በአኗኗራችሁ አሳዩ። \v 9 “አብርሃም ቅድመ አያታችን ስለ ሆነ ምንም አያስፈራንም” ብላችሁ አታስቡ። እነግራችኋለሁ፣ እግዚአብሔር ከእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆችን ሊያስገኝ ይችላል።

ru.L: Итак, принесите плод, достойный покаяния, \v 9 и не думайте говорить в себе: “Отцом мы имеем Авраама”, ведь говорю вам, что Бог может из этих камней поднять детей Аврааму.
ru.B: Так приносите же плод, который покажет, что ваше покаяние настоящее. \v 9 И не думайте успокаивать себя словами: “Наш отец — Авраам.” Говорю вам, Бог может сделать детей Аврааму из этих камней.
ru.R: Покажите своей жизнью, что вы действительно оставили свои грехи. \v 9 И не думайте: “Мы в безопасности, ведь Авраам — наш предок.” Говорю вам, Бог может сделать детей для Авраама из этих камней.

hi.L: इसलिए मन फिराव के योग्य फल लाओ, \v 9 और अपने मन में यह कहने का विचार न करो, 'अब्राहम हमारा पिता है,' क्योंकि मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ कि परमेश्वर इन पत्थरों से अब्राहम के लिए सन्तान उत्पन्न कर सकते हैं।
hi.B: इसलिए ऐसे फल लाओ जो दिखाएँ कि तुम्हारा मन फिराव सच्चा है। \v 9 यह सोचकर अपने आप को तसल्ली मत दो कि 'अब्राहम हमारा पिता है।' मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ, परमेश्वर इन पत्थरों से भी अब्राहम के लिए सन्तान बना सकते हैं।
hi.R: अपने जीने के ढंग से दिखाओ कि तुम सचमुच अपने पापों से मुड़ गए हो। \v 9 यह मत सोचो, 'हम सुरक्षित हैं, क्योंकि अब्राहम हमारे पुरखे हैं।' मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ, परमेश्वर इन पत्थरों से भी अब्राहम के लिए सन्तान बना सकते हैं।

uk.L: Отже, принесіть плід, гідний покаяння, \v 9 і не думайте казати серед себе: “[За] батька маємо Авраама”, бо кажу вам, що Бог може з цього каміння підняти дітей Авраамові.
uk.B: Тож принесіть плід, який показує, що ваше покаяння справжнє. \v 9 І не втішайте себе думкою: “Наш батько — Авраам.” Кажу вам: Бог може з цього каміння створити дітей Авраамові.
uk.R: Покажіть своїм життям, що ви справді відвернулися від своїх гріхів. \v 9 І не думайте: “Ми в безпеці, бо Авраам — наш предок.” Кажу вам: Бог міг би з цього каміння зробити дітей для Авраама.

ja.L: だから、悔い改めにふさわしい実を結びなさい。\v 9 そして、『わたしたちにはアブラハムという父がいる』と心の中で言おうと思ってはならない。あなたがたに言うが、神はこれらの石からでも、アブラハムのために子らを起こすことがおできになるのである。
ja.B: だから、悔い改めが本物であることを示す実を結びなさい。\v 9 『わたしたちの父はアブラハムだ』と言って、安心していられると思ってはならない。言っておくが、神はこれらの石からでも、アブラハムの子どもたちを造り出すことがおできになる。
ja.R: だから、悪い生き方から本当に立ち返ったことを、毎日の生き方で示しなさい。\v 9 『わたしたちはアブラハムの子孫だから大丈夫だ』と思ってはいけない。言っておくが、神は、ここにある石ころからでも、アブラハムの子どもたちを造ることがおできになる。

id.L: Karena itu hasilkanlah buah yang sesuai dengan pertobatan, \v 9 dan jangan mengira bahwa kalian dapat berkata dalam hati, 'Kami mempunyai Abraham [sebagai] bapa,' sebab aku berkata kepada kalian bahwa Allah sanggup membangkitkan anak-anak bagi Abraham dari batu-batu ini.
id.B: Jadi hasilkanlah buah yang menunjukkan bahwa pertobatan kalian sungguh-sungguh. \v 9 Jangan mengira kalian dapat menenangkan diri dengan berkata, 'Abraham adalah bapa kami.' Aku berkata kepada kalian, Allah sanggup menjadikan anak-anak bagi Abraham dari batu-batu ini.
id.R: Tunjukkan dengan perbuatan kalian bahwa kalian sungguh sudah bertobat. \v 9 Jangan berpikir, 'Kami ini keturunan Abraham, jadi kami aman.' Ketahuilah, Allah bisa membuat batu-batu ini menjadi keturunan Abraham.

zh.L: 所以你们要结出与悔改相称的果子，\v 9 也不要自以为可以在心里说：‘我们有亚伯拉罕[作]父亲。’因为我告诉你们，{{god_term:神|上帝}}有能力从这些石头为亚伯拉罕兴起儿女。
zh.B: 所以，要结出果子来，表明你们的悔改是真的。\v 9 不要以为可以这样安慰自己：‘亚伯拉罕是我们的父亲。’我告诉你们，{{god_term:神|上帝}}能用这些石头为亚伯拉罕造出儿女来。
zh.R: 你们要用自己的生活表明，你们真的离开了罪。\v 9 不要心里想：‘我们没事，因为亚伯拉罕是我们的祖先。’我告诉你们，{{god_term:神|上帝}}可以用这些石头为亚伯拉罕造出儿女来。

fa.L: پس ثمره‌ای شایستهٔ توبه بیاورید، \v 9 و گمان مبرید که در دل خود بگویید: “پدری چون ابراهیم داریم”، زیرا به شما می‌گویم که خدا قادر است از این سنگ‌ها فرزندانی برای ابراهیم برانگیزد.
fa.B: پس ثمره‌ای بیاورید که نشان دهد توبهٔ شما راستین است. \v 9 گمان مبرید که می‌توانید با گفتن “ابراهیم پدر ماست” خود را دلخوش کنید. به شما می‌گویم که خدا می‌تواند از این سنگ‌ها فرزندانی برای ابراهیم به وجود آورد.
fa.R: با شیوهٔ زندگی‌تان نشان دهید که براستی از گناهانتان دست کشیده‌اید. \v 9 با خود فکر نکنید که “ما در امانیم، زیرا ابراهیم جد ماست.” به شما می‌گویم، خدا می‌تواند این سنگ‌ها را به فرزندان ابراهیم تبدیل کند!

decisions.choice: fruit worthy of repentance: deeds that match a changed life
decisions.reason: Fruit is a picture of what a life produces. John asks for a changed life to show itself in deeds (7:16-20).

decisions.choice: We have Abraham as father: trust that belonging to Abraham's family is enough
decisions.reason: God's promises to Abraham and his descendants (Genesis 17:7) could be taken as a guarantee for every descendant. John says descent does not take the place of repentance.

decisions.choice: from these stones children: perhaps a play on words
decisions.reason: In Hebrew and Aramaic the words for "stones" and "sons" sound alike. If John spoke Aramaic, his hearers may have heard the play. Isaiah 51:1-2 also calls Abraham the rock from which Israel was cut.

decisions.choice: fruit that shows your repentance is real (B); show by the way you live (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture and says what it shows; Readable states the meaning.

decisions.choice: We are safe, because Abraham is our ancestor
alternatives: We have Abraham as our father
decisions.reason: Readable states what the saying was meant to claim.

decisions.choice: "kết quả" (L, B) for producing fruit
decisions.reason: "Kết quả" means both to bear fruit and a result, so it keeps the picture and its sense; 3:10 says "trái" for the fruit of the tree, the same Greek word.

decisions.choice: "神は……おできになる"
decisions.reason: John speaks of God with the light respect form that the narration uses for God.

decisions.choice: "kami" in the quoted claim (exclusive)
decisions.reason: The Pharisees and Sadducees would say it of themselves, apart from John.
