source.text: ἤδη δὲ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται· πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

records.literal_gloss: Already then the ax at the root of the trees lies; every therefore tree not producing fruit good is cut down and into fire is thrown.

en.L: And already the ax lies at the root of the trees; so every tree not producing good fruit is cut down and thrown into [the] fire.
en.B: The ax is already set against the root of the trees. Any tree that fails to bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
en.R: The ax is ready at the roots of the trees. God's judgment is that close. Every tree that does not grow good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

es.L: Ya el hacha yace junto a la raíz de los árboles; así que todo árbol que no da fruto bueno se corta y se echa al fuego.
es.B: El hacha ya está colocada junto a la raíz de los árboles. Cualquier árbol que no dé buen fruto se corta y se arroja al fuego.
es.R: El hacha está lista junto a las raíces de los árboles. El juicio de Dios está así de cerca. Todo árbol que no dé buen fruto será cortado y echado al fuego.

fr.L: Et déjà la hache est placée à la racine des arbres ; tout arbre donc qui ne produit pas de bon fruit est coupé et jeté au feu.
fr.B: La hache est déjà posée contre la racine des arbres. Tout arbre qui ne porte pas de bon fruit, on l’abat et on le jette au feu.
fr.R: La hache est prête, au pied des arbres. Le jugement de Dieu est aussi proche que cela. Tout arbre qui ne donne pas de bons fruits sera coupé et jeté dans le feu.

sw.L: Tayari shoka lipo kwenye mzizi wa miti; kwa hiyo kila mti ambao hauzai tunda zuri unakatwa na kutupwa katika moto.
sw.B: Shoka limekwisha kuwekwa kwenye mizizi ya miti. Mti wowote usiozaa matunda mazuri unakatwa na kutupwa motoni.
sw.R: Shoka liko tayari kwenye mizizi ya miti. Hukumu ya Mungu iko karibu hivyo. Kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri utakatwa na kutupwa motoni.

ko.L: 이미 도끼가 나무들의 뿌리에 놓여 있다. 그러므로 좋은 열매를 맺지 않는 나무는 모두 찍혀서 불 속에 던져진다.
ko.B: 도끼가 벌써 나무뿌리에 닿아 있다. 좋은 열매를 맺지 못하는 나무는 어느 것이나 베어져 불에 던져진다.
ko.R: 나무뿌리에 도끼가 벌써 놓여 있다. 하나님의 심판이 그만큼 가까이 왔다. 좋은 열매를 맺지 않는 나무는 모두 베어져 불 속에 던져질 것이다.

vi.L: Và cái rìu đã đặt sẵn nơi rễ cây; vậy mọi cây không sinh trái tốt đều bị đốn và ném vào lửa.
vi.B: Cái rìu đã kề sẵn gốc cây. Cây nào không sinh trái tốt sẽ bị đốn đi và ném vào lửa.
vi.R: Cái rìu đã sẵn sàng bên gốc cây. Sự phán xét của Đức Chúa Trời đã gần đến như vậy. Cây nào không sinh trái tốt sẽ bị chặt đi và ném vào lửa.

pt.L: E já o machado está junto à raiz das árvores; assim, toda árvore que não dá fruto bom é derrubada e jogada no fogo.
pt.B: O machado já está encostado à raiz das árvores. Toda árvore que deixa de dar bom fruto é derrubada e atirada ao fogo.
pt.R: O machado já está pronto, junto às raízes das árvores. O julgamento de Deus está perto assim. Toda árvore que não dá frutos bons vai ser derrubada e jogada no fogo.

am.L: መጥረቢያውም ከአሁኑ በዛፎቹ ሥር ተቀምጧል፤ ስለዚህ መልካም ፍሬ የማያፈራ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቆረጣል፤ ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።
am.B: መጥረቢያው አሁን እንኳ በዛፎቹ ሥር ላይ ተደግኗል። መልካም ፍሬ የማይሰጥ ዛፍ ሁሉ ተቆርጦ ወደ እሳት ይጣላል።
am.R: መጥረቢያው ዛፎቹን ከሥራቸው ለመቁረጥ ተዘጋጅቷል። የእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ ያን ያህል ቀርቧል። መልካም ፍሬ የማያፈራ ዛፍ ሁሉ ተቆርጦ ወደ እሳት ይጣላል።

ru.L: Уже же топор при корне деревьев лежит; итак, всякое дерево, не приносящее доброго плода, срубается и в огонь бросается.
ru.B: Топор уже лежит у корня деревьев. Каждое дерево, которое не приносит хорошего плода, срубают и бросают в огонь.
ru.R: Топор уже готов у корней деревьев. Так близок Божий суд. Каждое дерево, которое не даёт хороших плодов, срубят и бросят в огонь.

hi.L: और अब कुल्हाड़ा पेड़ों की जड़ पर रखा हुआ है; इसलिए जो-जो पेड़ अच्छा फल नहीं लाता, वह काटा और आग में डाला जाता है।
hi.B: कुल्हाड़ा पेड़ों की जड़ पर रखा जा चुका है। जो भी पेड़ अच्छा फल नहीं लाता, वह काटकर आग में डाल दिया जाता है।
hi.R: कुल्हाड़ी पेड़ों की जड़ों के पास तैयार रखी है। परमेश्वर का न्याय इतना पास है। जो पेड़ अच्छा फल नहीं देता, उसे काटकर आग में डाल दिया जाएगा।

uk.L: Уже ж і сокира лежить при корені дерев; отже, кожне дерево, що не приносить доброго плоду, зрубують і кидають у вогонь.
uk.B: Сокира вже прикладена до кореня дерев. Кожне дерево, яке не родить доброго плоду, зрубують і кидають у вогонь.
uk.R: Сокира вже готова біля коріння дерев. Божий суд уже так близько. Кожне дерево, на якому не росте добрий плід, зрубають і кинуть у вогонь.

ja.L: 斧はすでに木々の根もとに置かれている。だから、良い実を結ばない木はみな、切り倒されて火に投げ込まれる。
ja.B: 斧はもう木の根もとに当てられている。良い実を結ばない木は、どれも切り倒されて火に投げ込まれる。
ja.R: 斧は、もう木の根もとに置かれている。神のさばきは、それほど近いのだ。良い実を結ばない木は、みな切り倒されて、火に投げ込まれる。

id.L: Dan kapak sudah tersedia pada akar pohon-pohon; jadi setiap pohon yang tidak menghasilkan buah yang baik ditebang dan dibuang ke dalam api.
id.B: Kapak sudah diletakkan pada akar pohon-pohon. Setiap pohon yang tidak menghasilkan buah yang baik akan ditebang dan dibuang ke dalam api.
id.R: Kapak sudah siap untuk menebang pohon sampai ke akarnya. Setiap pohon yang tidak berbuah baik akan ditebang dan dibakar.

zh.L: 而且斧头已经摆在树木的根上；所以，每一棵不结好果实的树，都要被砍倒，扔进火中。
zh.B: 斧头已经对准了树根。任何不结好果实的树，都要被砍倒，扔到火里去。
zh.R: 斧头已经放在树根旁边，准备好了。{{god_term:神|上帝}}的审判就是这么近。哪一棵树不结好果子，就会被砍倒，扔进火里。

fa.L: و اکنون تیشه بر ریشهٔ درختان نهاده شده است؛ پس هر درختی که ثمرهٔ نیکو نیاورد، بریده و در آتش افکنده می‌شود.
fa.B: هم‌اکنون تیشه بر ریشهٔ درختان نهاده شده است، و هر درختی که میوهٔ خوب ندهد، بریده و در آتش افکنده می‌شود.
fa.R: تبر کنار ریشهٔ درختان آماده است. داوری خدا این‌قدر نزدیک است. هر درختی که میوهٔ خوب ندهد، بریده و در آتش انداخته خواهد شد.

decisions.choice: the ax at the root: judgment is about to fall
decisions.reason: The ax is laid at the root, ready for the first stroke. The trees are the people; the fire is God's judgment (3:12; 7:19).

decisions.choice: is cut down, is thrown: certain, and as good as happening
alternatives: a general rule with no reference to time
decisions.reason: The present tense speaks of what will surely happen as if it were already under way.

decisions.choice: God's judgment is that close
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture and says what it means.

source.text: Ἐγὼ μὲν ὑμᾶς βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι εἰς μετάνοιαν· ὁ δὲ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἰσχυρότερός μού ἐστιν, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς τὰ ὑποδήματα βαστάσαι· αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί·

records.literal_gloss: I indeed you baptize in water for repentance; the but after me coming stronger than me is, of whom not I am fit the sandals to carry; he you will baptize in Spirit Holy and fire;

en.L: I baptize you in water for repentance, but the one coming after me is stronger than I, whose sandals I am not fit to carry; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will baptize you in [the] Holy Spirit and fire.
en.B: I baptize you with water for repentance. But one who comes after me is mightier than I am, and I am not fit even to carry {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
en.R: I baptize you with water to show that you have turned away from your sins. But someone is coming after me who is much greater than I am. I am not good enough even to carry {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

es.L: Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizo en agua para arrepentimiento, pero el que viene después de mí es más fuerte que yo, cuyas sandalias no soy apto para cargar; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizará en [el] Espíritu Santo y fuego.
es.B: Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizo con agua para arrepentimiento. Pero el que viene después de mí es más poderoso que yo, y yo no soy digno ni siquiera de llevar {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sandalias. Él {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizará con el Espíritu Santo y con fuego.
es.R: Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizo con agua para mostrar que {{plural_you:se han apartado|os habéis apartado}} de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados. Pero viene después de mí alguien mucho más grande que yo. Yo no merezco ni siquiera llevar {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sandalias. Él {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizará con el Espíritu Santo y con fuego.

fr.L: Moi, je vous baptise dans l’eau en vue de la repentance ; mais celui qui vient après moi est plus fort que moi, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dont je ne suis pas apte à porter les sandales ; {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} vous baptisera dans l’Esprit Saint et le feu.
fr.B: Moi, je vous baptise avec de l’eau, en vue de la repentance. Mais celui qui vient après moi est plus puissant que moi, et je ne suis même pas digne de porter {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} sandales. Lui vous baptisera avec l’Esprit Saint et avec le feu.
fr.R: Moi, je vous baptise avec de l’eau pour montrer que vous vous êtes détournés de vos péchés. Mais quelqu’un vient après moi, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est beaucoup plus grand que moi. Je ne suis même pas assez bon pour porter {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} sandales. Lui vous baptisera avec l’Esprit Saint et avec le feu.

sw.L: Mimi nawabatiza ninyi katika maji kwa ajili ya toba; lakini anayekuja baada yangu ana nguvu kuliko mimi, ambaye mimi sifai kuzibeba ndara {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atawabatiza ninyi katika Roho Mtakatifu na moto.
sw.B: Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji kwa ajili ya toba. Lakini yule anayekuja baada yangu ana nguvu kuliko mimi, nami sifai hata kubeba ndara {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu na kwa moto.
sw.R: Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji kuonyesha kwamba mmeacha dhambi zenu. Lakini anakuja mtu baada yangu aliye mkuu sana kuliko mimi. Mimi sistahili hata kubeba ndara {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu na kwa moto.

ko.L: 나는 회개를 위하여 너희에게 물로 세례를 준다. 그러나 내 뒤에 오시는 분은 나보다 더 강하시다. 나는 그분의 신발을 들고 다닐 자격도 없다. 그분은 너희에게 성령과 불로 세례를 주실 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 너희가 회개하도록 물로 세례를 준다. 그러나 내 뒤에 오시는 분은 나보다 더 능력이 있으시다. 나는 그분의 신발을 들어 드릴 자격조차 없다. 그분은 성령과 불로 너희에게 세례를 주실 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 너희가 죄에서 돌이켰다는 표시로 물로 세례를 준다. 그러나 내 뒤에 오시는 분은 나보다 훨씬 더 크신 분이다. 나는 그분의 신발을 들어 드릴 만한 사람도 못 된다. 그분은 성령과 불로 너희에게 세례를 주실 것이다.

vi.L: Tôi làm báp-têm cho các người trong nước để ăn năn, nhưng Đấng đến sau tôi có quyền năng hơn tôi, tôi không xứng đáng xách dép cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm báp-têm cho các người trong Đức Thánh Linh và lửa.
vi.B: Tôi làm báp-têm cho các người bằng nước để ăn năn. Nhưng Đấng đến sau tôi có quyền năng hơn tôi, và tôi không đáng xách dép cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài sẽ làm báp-têm cho các người bằng Đức Thánh Linh và bằng lửa.
vi.R: Tôi dùng nước để làm báp-têm cho các người, để cho thấy các người đã từ bỏ tội lỗi. Nhưng có một Đấng sẽ đến sau tôi, lớn hơn tôi rất nhiều. Tôi không xứng đáng ngay cả xách dép cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài sẽ làm báp-têm cho các người bằng Đức Thánh Linh và bằng lửa.

pt.L: Eu os batizo em água para arrependimento; mas aquele que vem depois de mim é mais forte do que eu, cujas sandálias não sou digno de carregar; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os batizará no Espírito Santo e em fogo.
pt.B: Eu os batizo com água para o arrependimento. Mas aquele que vem depois de mim é mais poderoso do que eu, e eu não sou digno nem de carregar as sandálias {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Ele os batizará com o Espírito Santo e com fogo.
pt.R: Eu batizo vocês com água para mostrar que vocês abandonaram os seus pecados. Mas alguém muito maior do que eu vem depois de mim. Eu não mereço nem carregar as sandálias {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Ele vai batizar vocês com o Espírito Santo e com fogo.

am.L: እኔ ለንስሓ በውኃ አጠምቃችኋለሁ፤ ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው ግን ከእኔ የበረታ ነው፤ ጫማውን ለመሸከም እንኳ ብቁ አይደለሁም፤ እርሱ ራሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስና በእሳት ያጠምቃችኋል።
am.B: እኔ ለንስሓ በውኃ አጠምቃችኋለሁ። ነገር ግን ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው ከእኔ እጅግ የሚበልጥ ኃያል ነው፤ እኔ ጫማውን እንኳ ለመሸከም አልበቃም። እርሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስና በእሳት ያጠምቃችኋል።
am.R: እኔ በውኃ የማጠምቃችሁ ከኃጢአታችሁ መመለሳችሁን ለማሳየት ነው። ነገር ግን ከእኔ እጅግ የሚበልጥ አንድ ሰው ከእኔ በኋላ ይመጣል። እኔ ጫማውን እንኳ ለመሸከም የሚገባኝ ሰው አይደለሁም። እርሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስና በእሳት ያጠምቃችኋል።

ru.L: Я крещу вас в воде для покаяния, но идущий за мной сильнее меня, чьи сандалии я не достоин нести; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} будет крестить вас в Святом Духе и огне.
ru.B: Я крещу вас водой для покаяния. Но тот, кто идёт за мной, сильнее меня, и я не достоин даже нести {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} сандалии. Он будет крестить вас Святым Духом и огнём.
ru.R: Я крещу вас водой, чтобы показать, что вы оставили свои грехи. Но за мной идёт тот, кто гораздо больше меня. Я недостоин даже носить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} сандалии. Он будет крестить вас Святым Духом и огнём.

hi.L: मैं तो तुम्हें मन फिराव के लिए पानी में बपतिस्मा देता हूँ, पर जो मेरे बाद आनेवाले हैं, वे मुझसे अधिक सामर्थी हैं, जिनकी जूतियाँ उठाने के मैं योग्य नहीं; वे तुम्हें पवित्र आत्मा और आग में बपतिस्मा देंगे।
hi.B: मैं तो तुम्हें मन फिराव के लिए पानी से बपतिस्मा देता हूँ। पर जो मेरे बाद आनेवाले हैं, वे मुझसे अधिक सामर्थी हैं, और मैं उनकी जूतियाँ उठाने के भी योग्य नहीं। वे तुम्हें पवित्र आत्मा से और आग से बपतिस्मा देंगे।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें पानी से बपतिस्मा देता हूँ, यह दिखाने के लिए कि तुम अपने पापों से मुड़ गए हो। पर मेरे बाद कोई आ रहे हैं जो मुझसे बहुत बड़े हैं। मैं उनकी जूतियाँ उठाने के लायक़ भी नहीं हूँ। वे तुम्हें पवित्र आत्मा से और आग से बपतिस्मा देंगे।

uk.L: Я хрещу вас у воді на покаяння, а той, хто йде після мене, сильніший за мене, чиїх сандалів я не гідний нести; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} хреститиме вас у Святому Дусі й вогні.
uk.B: Я хрещу вас водою на покаяння. Але той, хто йде після мене, могутніший за мене, і я не гідний навіть нести {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} сандалі. Він хреститиме вас Святим Духом і вогнем.
uk.R: Я хрещу вас водою, щоб показати, що ви відвернулися від своїх гріхів. Але після мене йде той, хто набагато більший за мене. Я не гідний навіть нести {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} сандалі. Він хреститиме вас Святим Духом і вогнем.

ja.L: わたしは悔い改めのために、水においてあなたがたに洗礼を授けている。しかし、わたしの後から来られる方は、わたしより力のある方である。わたしはその方の履物を運ぶ値打ちもない。その方は、聖霊と火においてあなたがたに洗礼を授けられる。
ja.B: わたしは、悔い改めのために水であなたがたに洗礼を授けている。しかし、わたしの後から来られる方は、わたしよりも力のある方で、わたしはその方の履物を運ぶ値打ちもない。その方は聖霊と火であなたがたに洗礼を授けられる。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたたちが悪い生き方から立ち返ったしるしとして、水で洗礼を授けている。しかし、わたしの後から来られる方は、わたしよりずっと偉い方だ。わたしには、その方のサンダルを運ぶ値打ちさえない。その方は、聖霊と火であなたたちに洗礼を授けられる。

id.L: Aku membaptis kalian dalam air untuk pertobatan, tetapi {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} yang datang sesudah aku lebih berkuasa daripada aku, yang kasut-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} pun aku tidak layak membawanya; {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} akan membaptis kalian dalam Roh Kudus dan api.
id.B: Aku membaptis kalian dengan air untuk pertobatan. Tetapi {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} yang datang sesudah aku lebih berkuasa daripada aku, dan membawa kasut-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} pun aku tidak layak. Dia akan membaptis kalian dengan Roh Kudus dan dengan api.
id.R: Aku membaptis kalian dengan air sebagai tanda bahwa kalian sudah bertobat. Tetapi sesudah aku akan datang Seseorang yang jauh lebih berkuasa daripada aku. Membawakan sandal-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} saja aku tidak pantas. Dia akan membaptis kalian dengan Roh Kudus dan dengan api.

zh.L: 我在水中为你们施洗，是为了悔改；但在我之后要来的那一位比我强大，我连为{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}拿凉鞋都不配；{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要在圣灵和火中为你们施洗。
zh.B: 我用水为你们施洗，是要你们悔改。但在我以后要来的那一位比我强大得多，我甚至不配替{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}拿鞋。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要用圣灵和火为你们施洗。
zh.R: 我用水为你们施洗，表明你们已经离开了罪。但是有一位要在我以后来，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}比我伟大得多。我连替{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}拿鞋子都不够资格。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要用圣灵和火为你们施洗。

fa.L: من شما را در آب برای توبه تعمید می‌دهم، اما آن که پس از من می‌آید از من تواناتر است، که من شایستهٔ برداشتن کفش‌هایش نیستم؛ او شما را در روح‌القدس و آتش تعمید خواهد داد.
fa.B: من شما را با آب برای توبه تعمید می‌دهم. اما کسی که پس از من می‌آید از من تواناتر است، و من حتی شایسته نیستم کفش‌هایش را بردارم. او شما را با روح‌القدس و با آتش تعمید خواهد داد.
fa.R: من شما را با آب تعمید می‌دهم تا نشان دهم که از گناهانتان دست کشیده‌اید. اما کسی پس از من می‌آید که بسیار بزرگ‌تر از من است. من حتی لیاقت ندارم کفش‌هایش را برایش ببرم. او شما را با روح‌القدس و با آتش تعمید خواهد داد.

decisions.choice: for repentance: a baptism that goes with turning back to God
alternatives: a baptism that brings about repentance
a baptism because they had repented
decisions.reason: The phrase says only that John's baptism has to do with repentance. It may call people to repent or mark their repenting; John's demand for fruit (3:8) suggests both.

decisions.choice: the one coming after me: the Messiah, whom John does not name
decisions.reason: John speaks of someone greater who will come after him. The next scene shows that it is Jesus (3:13-17).

decisions.choice: carry his sandals: the task of the lowest slave
decisions.reason: Carrying or untying a master's sandals was a slave's job. John says he is not worthy even of that.

decisions.choice: with the Holy Spirit and fire: the Spirit for those who repent, fire as judgment
alternatives: the Spirit and fire as one cleansing gift
fire as the Spirit's power only
decisions.reason: "You" has one verb and one preposition for both, so the baptism is one act. In the verses before and after, fire is judgment (3:10, 12), and the wheat and the chaff are two groups. Others read the fire as the Spirit's cleansing (Malachi 3:2-3).

decisions.choice: in water, in the Holy Spirit (L); with water, with the Holy Spirit (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek preposition can mean "in" or "with". Literal keeps "in", the picture of being immersed; Balanced and Readable use the usual English "with".

decisions.choice: to show that you have turned away from your sins
decisions.reason: Readable gives one of the senses the meaning note describes; the note says the phrase may also be a call to repent.

decisions.choice: apte (L); digne (B)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:7: the word means fit for a task. Literal keeps that sense with "apte"; "je ne suis pas digne de" is the natural French way to say one is not fit even for the lowest service (m3).

decisions.choice: ndara
decisions.reason: "Viatu" is footwear in general and now suggests shoes; "ndara" are open sandals tied to the foot, as the Greek word means. Carrying them was a slave's task (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: John speaks of the one coming with the honorific ("오시는 분", "그분", "주실 것이다")
decisions.reason: John knows the one coming is greater than he is; Korean shows it with -시- and "분", as in the Korean Mark 1:7-8.

decisions.choice: "Đấng" for the one coming
decisions.reason: John speaks of the Messiah without naming him; "Đấng" is the honouring word for a person, as in Mark 1:7, and makes the comparison with John himself clear.

decisions.choice: honorific "वे", "जिनकी" for the one coming
decisions.reason: John speaks of the one greater than himself with the honorific, as Hindi speaks of a superior.
Literal keeps the Greek preposition "in"; Balanced and Readable say it as Hindi speaks of baptism.

decisions.choice: John speaks of the coming one with respect forms ("来られる方", "授けられる")
decisions.reason: John ranks himself below a slave beside the one who is coming (m3); a Japanese speaker saying that would speak of him with respect. This is John's own register, as in Mark 1:7-8.

decisions.choice: "水において", "聖霊と火において" (L); "水で", "聖霊と火で" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "in" or "with". Literal keeps the wider "において", as Mark 1:8 does; Balanced and Readable use the ordinary "で".

decisions.choice: John says "aku"; the coming one is "Dia" with capitals
decisions.reason: John speaks to the crowd as a prophet; Indonesian capitalises the coming one's pronouns, which here are the only sign that John means someone greater than himself.

decisions.choice: "在水中", "在圣灵和火中" (L); "用水", "用圣灵和火" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek preposition can mean "in" or "with". Literal keeps the picture of immersion; Balanced and Readable use the ordinary Chinese for the means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: plain "او" for the one coming
decisions.reason: Persian uses no honorific plural for him, as in Mark 1:7.

decisions.choice: "در آب", "در روح‌القدس" (Literal); "با" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Greek en; Literal follows it, as in Mark 1:8.

source.text: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ διακαθαριεῖ τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ καὶ συνάξει τὸν σῖτον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην, τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ.

records.literal_gloss: Of whom the winnowing fork in the hand of him, and he will clear out the threshing floor of him and will gather the wheat of him into the barn, the but chaff he will burn up with fire unquenchable.

en.L: His winnowing fork [is] in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will clear out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} threshing floor and gather {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wheat into the barn, but the chaff {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will burn up with unquenchable fire."
en.B: He has {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} winnowing fork in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will clear {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} threshing floor. He will gather {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wheat into the barn, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will burn up the chaff with a fire that cannot be put out."
en.R: He is like a farmer who is ready to separate wheat from chaff. He has the tool for it in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand. He will clean {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} threshing floor and put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wheat in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} barn. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will burn the chaff in a fire that never goes out."

es.L: Su horquilla de aventar [está] en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano, y limpiará a fondo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} era, y juntará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trigo en el granero, pero la paja la consumirá con fuego inextinguible».
es.B: Ya tiene en la mano {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} horquilla de aventar, y limpiará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} era. Recogerá {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trigo en el granero, pero quemará la paja en un fuego que nadie puede apagar».
es.R: Él es como un campesino que está listo para separar el trigo de la paja. Tiene en la mano la herramienta para hacerlo. Limpiará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} era y guardará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trigo en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} granero. Pero quemará la paja en un fuego que nunca se apaga».

fr.L: Sa pelle à vanner [est] dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nettoiera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} aire, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rassemblera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} blé dans le grenier, mais la balle, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la brûlera dans un feu inextinguible. »
fr.B: Il tient en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} pelle à vanner, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} va nettoyer {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} aire. Il amassera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} blé dans le grenier, mais la paille, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la brûlera dans un feu qui ne s’éteint jamais. »
fr.R: Il est comme un paysan prêt à séparer le grain de la paille. Il a l’outil pour le faire dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main. Il va nettoyer l’endroit où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} bat le blé, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} va mettre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} blé dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} grenier. Mais la paille, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la brûlera dans un feu qui ne s’éteint jamais. »

sw.L: Chombo {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha kupepetea kiko mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, naye atausafisha kabisa uwanja {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kupuria, na kuikusanya ngano {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ghalani, lakini makapi atayachoma kwa moto usioweza kuzimwa."
sw.B: Anacho chombo {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha kupepetea mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, naye atausafisha uwanja {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kupuria. Ataikusanya ngano {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ghalani, lakini makapi atayateketeza kwa moto ambao hauwezi kuzimwa."
sw.R: Yeye ni kama mkulima aliye tayari kutenganisha ngano na makapi. Ana kifaa cha kazi hiyo mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. Atasafisha uwanja {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kupuria na kuiweka ngano {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ghalani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. Lakini makapi atayachoma kwa moto ambao hauzimiki kamwe."

ko.L: 그분의 손에 넉가래가 [들려] 있다. 그리고 그분은 자기 타작마당을 깨끗이 하시고, 자기 밀을 곳간에 모아들이시고, 쭉정이는 꺼지지 않는 불로 태워 버리실 것이다."
ko.B: 그분은 손에 넉가래를 들고 계신다. 그분은 타작마당을 깨끗이 하셔서, 밀은 곳간에 모아들이시고, 쭉정이는 꺼지지 않는 불에 태워 버리실 것이다."
ko.R: 그분은 밀과 쭉정이를 가르려고 준비하고 있는 농부와 같다. 그분은 그 일을 할 넉가래를 손에 들고 계신다. 그분은 타작마당을 깨끗이 하시고, 밀은 곳간에 모아들이실 것이다. 그러나 쭉정이는 결코 꺼지지 않는 불에 태워 버리실 것이다."

vi.L: Cái nia [ở] trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ dọn sạch sân đập lúa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và thu lúa mì của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào kho, còn trấu thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đốt trong lửa không hề tắt."
vi.B: Ngài cầm sẵn nia trong tay để dọn sạch sân đập lúa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài sẽ thu lúa mì vào kho, còn trấu thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đốt trong lửa không bao giờ tắt."
vi.R: Ngài giống như một người nông dân sẵn sàng tách lúa mì ra khỏi trấu. Ngài đã cầm sẵn dụng cụ trong tay. Ngài sẽ dọn sạch sân đập lúa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và đem lúa mì cất vào kho. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đốt trấu trong lửa không bao giờ tắt."

pt.L: A pá de joeirar {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} [está] na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} limpará completamente a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} eira e recolherá o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trigo no celeiro, mas a palha {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} queimará com fogo que não se apaga."
pt.B: Ele tem a pá de joeirar na mão e limpará a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} eira. Recolherá o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trigo no celeiro, mas queimará a palha num fogo que ninguém pode apagar."
pt.R: Ele é como um agricultor que está pronto para separar o trigo da palha. Ele tem na mão a ferramenta para isso. Vai limpar o lugar onde o trigo é separado e guardar o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trigo no celeiro. Mas a palha {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai queimar num fogo que nunca se apaga."

am.L: መንሹ በእጁ [ነው]፤ አውድማውንም ጠራርጎ ያጸዳል፤ ስንዴውንም ወደ ጎተራው ያስገባል፤ ገለባውን ግን በማይጠፋ እሳት ያቃጥላል።»
am.B: መንሹን በእጁ ይዟል፤ አውድማውንም ያጸዳል። ስንዴውን በጎተራው ያከማቻል፤ ገለባውን ግን ሊጠፋ በማይችል እሳት ያቃጥላል።»
am.R: እርሱ ስንዴን ከገለባ ለመለየት እንደ ተዘጋጀ ገበሬ ነው። የሚለይበትን መሣሪያ በእጁ ይዟል። አውድማውን ያጸዳል፤ ስንዴውንም በጎተራው ያስገባል። ገለባውን ግን ፈጽሞ በማይጠፋ እሳት ያቃጥላል።»

ru.L: В руке {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} лопата для веяния, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} очистит своё гумно и соберёт свою пшеницу в амбар, а мякину сожжёт неугасимым огнём.»
ru.B: Лопата для веяния уже в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} руке, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} очистит своё гумно. Пшеницу {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} соберёт в амбар, а мякину сожжёт в огне, который невозможно погасить.»
ru.R: Он как хозяин, который готов отделить зерно от мякины. Лопата для этого уже у {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} в руке. Он очистит место, где молотят зерно, и соберёт свою пшеницу в амбар. А мякину {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сожжёт в огне, который никогда не гаснет.»

hi.L: उनका सूप उनके हाथ में [है], और वे अपना खलिहान अच्छी तरह साफ़ करेंगे और अपना गेहूँ खत्ते में इकट्ठा करेंगे, पर भूसी को उस आग में जला देंगे जो बुझने की नहीं।"
hi.B: उनका सूप उनके हाथ में है, और वे अपना खलिहान साफ़ करेंगे। वे अपना गेहूँ खत्ते में इकट्ठा करेंगे, पर भूसी को ऐसी आग में जला देंगे जो कभी नहीं बुझती।"
hi.R: वे उस किसान की तरह हैं जो गेहूँ को भूसी से अलग करने के लिए तैयार है। उसका औज़ार उनके हाथ में है। वे अपना खलिहान साफ़ करेंगे और अपना गेहूँ अपने गोदाम में रखेंगे। पर भूसी को वे ऐसी आग में जला देंगे जो कभी नहीं बुझती।"

uk.L: У {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} руці лопата для віяння, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} очистить свій тік, і збере свою пшеницю в комору, а полову спалить невгасимим вогнем.»
uk.B: Він тримає в руці лопату для віяння і очистить свій тік. Свою пшеницю {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} збере в комору, а полову спалить у вогні, якого не загасити.»
uk.R: Він наче хлібороб, який готовий відділити зерно від полови. У {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} руці вже є лопата для цього. Він очистить свій тік і збере свою пшеницю в комору. А полову {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} спалить у вогні, який ніколи не гасне.»

ja.L: その方の手には、ふるい分けの熊手がある。そして、ご自分の脱穀場を隅々まできれいにし、ご自分の麦を倉に集め、もみ殻は消えない火で焼き尽くされる。」
ja.B: その方は、手にふるい分けの熊手を持って、ご自分の脱穀場をすっかりきれいにされる。そして、麦は倉に納め、もみ殻は消えることのない火で焼き尽くされる。」
ja.R: その方は、麦ともみ殻をより分ける農夫のようだ。その道具を、もう手に持っておられる。そして脱穀場をきれいにして、麦を倉に入れられる。しかし、もみ殻は、いつまでも消えない火で焼いてしまわれる。」

id.L: Alat penampi ada di tangan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} akan membersihkan tempat pengirikan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} dan mengumpulkan gandum-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} ke dalam lumbung, tetapi sekam itu akan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} bakar dengan api yang tidak terpadamkan."
id.B: Alat penampi sudah ada di tangan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} akan membersihkan tempat pengirikan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}. Dia akan mengumpulkan gandum-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} ke dalam lumbung, tetapi sekamnya akan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} bakar dengan api yang tidak dapat dipadamkan."
id.R: Dia seperti petani yang memegang alat penampi di tangan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}. Dia akan membersihkan tempat pengirikan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}. Gandum-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} akan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} kumpulkan ke dalam lumbung, tetapi sekamnya akan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} bakar dengan api yang tidak pernah padam."

zh.L: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的扬场叉在{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}手中，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要清理{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的禾场，把{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的麦子收进仓里，至于糠秕，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要用不能熄灭的火烧掉。”
zh.B: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}手里拿着扬场的叉子，要清理{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的打谷场。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要把麦子收进{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的仓里，却要用永不熄灭的火把糠秕烧掉。”
zh.R: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}好像一个农夫，准备把麦子和糠分开。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}手里已经拿着扬场的工具。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要清理{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的打谷场，把{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的麦子收进{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的仓里，却要把糠放在永远不会熄灭的火里烧掉。”

fa.L: چارشاخ او در دست اوست، و خرمنگاه خود را پاک خواهد کرد و گندم خود را در انبار گرد خواهد آورد، اما کاه را در آتشی خاموش‌نشدنی خواهد سوزاند.»
fa.B: چارشاخ او در دست اوست، و خرمنگاهش را پاک خواهد کرد. گندمش را در انبار گرد خواهد آورد، اما کاه را در آتشی که هرگز خاموش نمی‌شود خواهد سوزاند.»
fa.R: او مانند کشاورزی است که آماده است گندم را از کاه جدا کند. ابزار این کار در دست اوست. خرمنگاهش را پاک خواهد کرد و گندمش را در انبارش خواهد گذاشت. اما کاه را در آتشی که هرگز خاموش نمی‌شود خواهد سوزاند.»

decisions.choice: winnowing fork, threshing floor, chaff: the work of separating grain at harvest
decisions.reason: After threshing, a farmer tossed the grain into the wind with a wooden fork on a hard, open floor. The wind carried off the light chaff and the grain fell back. The grain was stored, and the chaff was burned.

decisions.choice: the one coming will separate people at the judgment
alternatives: a picture of everyday life only
decisions.reason: The wheat and the chaff are the people who repent and those who do not, as with the good and bad trees of 3:10. Jesus uses the same kind of picture in 13:30.

decisions.choice: unquenchable fire: fire that no one can put out
alternatives: fire that burns for a short time
decisions.reason: The fire of judgment cannot be stopped (Isaiah 66:24; Mark 9:43, 48).

decisions.choice: whose: the relative ties this to 3:11, the one who is coming
decisions.reason: The verse begins with "whose", so it goes on speaking of the one coming after John.

decisions.choice: His winnowing fork (L); He has his winnowing fork (B); He is like a farmer (R)
decisions.reason: English does not begin a new sentence with "whose", so the levels begin with "his" or "he". Readable says the farmer is a comparison.

decisions.choice: horquilla de aventar
decisions.reason: The tool is a wooden fork for tossing threshed grain into the wind (meaning decision m1). "Aventador" and "bieldo" are not known everywhere; "horquilla de aventar" says what it is.

decisions.choice: la balle (L); la paille (B, R)
decisions.reason: "La balle" is the exact French word for the husks blown off the grain, but most readers today know it only as "ball". Balanced and Readable say "la paille", the everyday word for what is left once the grain is taken (m1).

decisions.choice: chombo cha kupepetea
decisions.reason: A "pepeto" is the flat tray used to winnow by shaking; the Greek tool is a fork for tossing grain into the wind (meaning decision m1). "Chombo cha kupepetea" (winnowing tool) names its use without the wrong picture.

decisions.choice: "넉가래" for the winnowing fork; "쭉정이" for the chaff
decisions.reason: The Greek tool is a wooden shovel or fork used to toss threshed grain into the wind; "넉가래" is the Korean wooden shovel used for the same work. "키" is a winnowing basket, a different tool. "쭉정이" is the empty husk that blows away, the plain word for what is worthless.

decisions.choice: "nia", "sân đập lúa", "trấu" for winnowing fork, threshing floor and chaff
decisions.reason: The Greek tool is a fork or shovel for tossing grain in the wind; Vietnamese farmers winnow with a "nia" (a flat tray), which does the same work and which every reader can picture. "Trấu" is the husk separated from the grain. Readable says "dụng cụ" (tool), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a pá de joeirar, a eira (L, B); a ferramenta, o lugar onde o trigo é separado (R)
decisions.reason: "Pá de joeirar" and "eira" are the Portuguese farm words for the winnowing tool and the threshing floor. Readable describes them, since few city readers know them; "terreiro" has other associations in Brazil.

decisions.choice: "सूप"
decisions.reason: The Greek names the tool for tossing grain into the wind; "सूप", the winnowing tool of an Indian threshing floor, does the same work and is known to every Hindi reader.

decisions.choice: 'своё гумно', 'свою пшеницу' without spans
decisions.reason: Russian says 'his own' with the reflexive 'свой', which takes no deity_pronoun span, so Russian has fewer spans here than the English.

decisions.choice: "лопата для віяння"
decisions.reason: The tool tossed the threshed grain into the wind. "Віялка" now names a winnowing machine; "лопата для віяння" names the hand tool and what it is for.

decisions.choice: "ふるい分けの熊手" (L, B); "麦ともみ殻をより分ける……道具" (R)
decisions.reason: The tool is a wooden fork used to toss threshed grain into the wind (m1). "箕" is a basket, and its kanji is hard to read; "ふるい分けの熊手" names a forked tool and its use.

decisions.choice: "その方の手には" (L); "その方は" (B); "その方は……農夫のようだ" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek begins with "whose", going on from 3:11 (m4). Japanese starts a new sentence with "その方", which keeps the link to the coming one.

decisions.choice: "扬场叉" (L); "扬场的叉子" (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek names a fork for tossing threshed grain into the wind, not a basket. Readable calls it a tool and explains the picture.

decisions.choice: "چارشاخ" (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 3:17.

alignments.target_span: すっかりきれいにされる

source.text: Τότε παραγίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰορδάνην πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην τοῦ βαπτισθῆναι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Then comes the Jesus from the Galilee to the Jordan to the John to be baptized by him.

en.L: Then Jesus comes from Galilee to the Jordan, to John, to be baptized by him.
en.B: Then Jesus arrived from Galilee and came to John at the Jordan, to be baptized by him.
en.R: Then Jesus traveled from Galilee to the Jordan River. He came to John so that John would baptize {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Entonces viene Jesús desde Galilea al Jordán, a Juan, para ser bautizado por él.
es.B: Entonces Jesús llegó de Galilea al Jordán, adonde estaba Juan, para ser bautizado por él.
es.R: Entonces Jesús viajó desde Galilea hasta el río Jordán. Fue a ver a Juan para que Juan {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} bautizara.

fr.L: Alors Jésus arrive de Galilée au Jourdain, auprès de Jean, pour être baptisé par lui.
fr.B: Alors Jésus vint de Galilée au Jourdain, auprès de Jean, pour se faire baptiser par lui.
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus est venu de Galilée jusqu’au fleuve Jourdain. Il est allé voir Jean pour que Jean {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} baptise.

sw.L: Ndipo Yesu anawasili kutoka Galilaya kwenye Yordani, kwa Yohana, ili kubatizwa naye.
sw.B: Kisha Yesu alifika kutoka Galilaya, akamwendea Yohana huko Yordani ili abatizwe naye.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu alisafiri kutoka Galilaya mpaka mto Yordani. Alimwendea Yohana ili Yohana ambatize.

ko.L: 그때 예수께서 갈릴리에서 요단으로 요한에게 오신다. 그에게 세례를 받으시려는 것이다.
ko.B: 그때 예수께서 요한에게 세례를 받으시려고 갈릴리에서 요단강으로 요한을 찾아오셨다.
ko.R: 그때 예수께서 갈릴리에서 요단강으로 가셨다. 요한에게 세례를 받으시려고 요한을 찾아가신 것이다.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Đức Giê-xu từ Ga-li-lê đến sông Giô-đanh, gặp Giăng để được ông làm báp-têm.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Đức Giê-xu từ Ga-li-lê đến với Giăng tại sông Giô-đanh để chịu báp-têm.
vi.R: Lúc ấy, Đức Giê-xu từ miền Ga-li-lê đi đến sông Giô-đanh. Ngài đến gặp Giăng để Giăng làm báp-têm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: Então Jesus vem da Galileia ao Jordão, até João, para ser batizado por ele.
pt.B: Então Jesus chegou da Galileia e foi até João, no Jordão, para ser batizado por ele.
pt.R: Então Jesus viajou da Galileia até o rio Jordão. Ele foi até João para que João {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} batizasse.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በእርሱ ለመጠመቅ ከገሊላ [ተነሥቶ] ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ወደ ዮሐንስ ይመጣል።
am.B: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ከገሊላ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መጥቶ በዮሐንስ ለመጠመቅ ወደ እርሱ ቀረበ።
am.R: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ከገሊላ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ተጓዘ። ዮሐንስ እንዲያጠምቀው ወደ እርሱ መጣ።

ru.L: Тогда приходит Иисус из Галилеи на Иордан к Иоанну, чтобы креститься у него.
ru.B: Тогда Иисус пришёл из Галилеи на Иордан к Иоанну, чтобы принять от него крещение.
ru.R: Потом Иисус пришёл из Галилеи к реке Иордан. Он пришёл к Иоанну, чтобы тот крестил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.

hi.L: तब यीशु गलील से यरदन पर यूहन्ना के पास आते हैं, कि उससे बपतिस्मा लें।
hi.B: तब यीशु गलील से यरदन के किनारे यूहन्ना के पास आए, ताकि उससे बपतिस्मा लें।
hi.R: फिर यीशु गलील से यरदन नदी पर आए। वे यूहन्ना के पास आए ताकि यूहन्ना उन्हें बपतिस्मा दे।

uk.L: Тоді приходить Ісус із Галилеї на Йордан до Івана, щоб хреститися від нього.
uk.B: Тоді Ісус прибув із Галилеї і прийшов до Івана на Йордан, щоб той охрестив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}.
uk.R: Тоді Ісус прийшов з Галилеї до річки Йордан. Він прийшов до Івана, щоб Іван охрестив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}.

ja.L: そのとき、イエスがガリラヤからヨルダン[川]へ、ヨハネのところに来られる。彼から洗礼を受けるためである。
ja.B: そのとき、イエスは、ヨハネから洗礼を受けるために、ガリラヤからヨルダン川のヨハネのもとに来られた。
ja.R: そのころ、イエスはガリラヤからヨルダン川へ行かれました。ヨハネから洗礼を受けるために、ヨハネのところに来られたのです。

id.L: Lalu Yesus datang dari Galilea ke Yordan, kepada Yohanes, untuk dibaptis olehnya.
id.B: Kemudian Yesus datang dari Galilea ke sungai Yordan, kepada Yohanes, untuk dibaptis olehnya.
id.R: Pada waktu itu Yesus datang dari Galilea ke sungai Yordan. Dia datang kepada Yohanes supaya Yohanes membaptis-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.

zh.L: 那时耶稣从加利利往约旦河来，到约翰那里，为要被他施洗。
zh.B: 那时，耶稣从加利利来到约旦河，到约翰那里，要接受约翰的洗礼。
zh.R: 后来，耶稣从加利利来到约旦河。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}到约翰那里，要约翰为{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}施洗。

fa.L: آن‌گاه عیسی از جلیل به اردن نزد یحیی می‌آید تا از او تعمید گیرد.
fa.B: آن‌گاه عیسی از جلیل رسید و در اردن نزد یحیی آمد تا از او تعمید بگیرد.
fa.R: آن‌گاه عیسی از جلیل به رود اردن رفت. نزد یحیی آمد تا یحیی او را تعمید دهد.

decisions.choice: to be baptized: Jesus comes for this purpose
decisions.reason: The verb form states his purpose. Jesus seeks baptism; John's protest follows.

decisions.choice: comes (L); came, arrived (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration; Balanced and Readable use the past.

decisions.choice: viene (L); llegó (B); viajó (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:13 and the English: Matthew uses the present tense here and in 3:1 and 3:15. Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable tell the story in the past.

decisions.choice: historic present kept at Literal (anawasili, and anajitokeza in 3:1); past at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As in 2:13: Matthew uses the present tense here and in 3:1 and 3:15. Literal keeps it, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the narrative past.

decisions.choice: honorific "आते हैं", "आए" for Jesus
decisions.reason: Jesus takes the honorific third person in the narrative throughout the book; Literal keeps the historic present.

decisions.choice: plain forms for Jesus ("می‌آید", "آمد")
decisions.reason: Persian uses no honorific plural for Jesus.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰωάννης διεκώλυεν αὐτὸν λέγων· Ἐγὼ χρείαν ἔχω ὑπὸ σοῦ βαπτισθῆναι, καὶ σὺ ἔρχῃ πρός με;

records.literal_gloss: The but John was preventing him saying, I need by you to be baptized, and you come to me?

en.L: But John tried to prevent {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, "I need to be baptized by {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} come to me?"
en.B: John tried to stop {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. "I am the one who needs to be baptized by {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}," he said, "and yet {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} come to me?"
en.R: But John tried to talk {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} out of it. He said, "I should be baptized by {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! Why are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} coming to me?"

es.L: Pero Juan {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} intentaba detener, diciendo: «Yo tengo necesidad de ser bautizado por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, ¿y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vienes a mí?».
es.B: Juan {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} quiso detener. «Soy yo quien necesita que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me bautices», dijo, «¿y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vienes a mí?».
es.R: Pero Juan {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} quería convencer de que no se bautizara. Le dijo: «¡Yo debería ser bautizado por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}! ¿Por qué vienes {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a mí?».

fr.L: Mais Jean cherchait à {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}en empêcher, disant : « Moi, j’ai besoin d’être baptisé par {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} viens à moi ? »
fr.B: Jean tenta de {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}en dissuader : « C’est moi qui ai besoin d’être baptisé par {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, dit-il, et c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui viens à moi ? »
fr.R: Mais Jean a essayé de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire changer d’avis. Il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a dit : « C’est moi qui devrais être baptisé par {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! Pourquoi est-ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} viens vers moi ? »

sw.L: Lakini Yohana aliendelea kumzuia, akisema, "Mimi nina haja ya kubatizwa na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unakuja kwangu?"
sw.B: Yohana alijaribu kumzuia. "Mimi ndiye ninayehitaji kubatizwa na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}," akasema, "lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unakuja kwangu?"
sw.R: Lakini Yohana alijaribu kumshawishi asibatizwe. Akasema, "Ningepaswa mimi kubatizwa na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}! Mbona {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unakuja kwangu?"

ko.L: 그러나 요한은 그분을 말리며 말하였다. "제가 선생님께 세례를 받아야 하는데, 선생님께서 제게 오십니까?"
ko.B: 요한이 그분을 말리며 말했다. "오히려 제가 선생님께 세례를 받아야 할 사람인데, 선생님께서 저에게 오시다니요?"
ko.R: 그러나 요한은 예수를 말리려고 했다. 요한이 말했다. "제가 선생님께 세례를 받아야 합니다! 그런데 왜 선생님께서 저에게 오십니까?"

vi.L: Nhưng Giăng cố ngăn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nói rằng: "Chính tôi cần được Thầy làm báp-têm, mà Thầy lại đến với tôi sao?"
vi.B: Nhưng Giăng cố can ngăn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Chính tôi mới cần được Thầy làm báp-têm, thế mà Thầy lại đến với tôi sao?"
vi.R: Nhưng Giăng cố thuyết phục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đừng làm vậy. Ông nói: "Tôi mới cần được Thầy làm báp-têm! Sao Thầy lại đến với tôi?"

pt.L: Mas João tentava impedi-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}, dizendo: "Eu preciso ser batizado por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vens a mim?"
pt.B: João tentou impedi-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}. "Sou eu que preciso ser batizado por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}", disse ele, "e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vens a mim?"
pt.R: Mas João tentou convencer Jesus a não fazer isso. Ele disse: "Eu é que devia ser batizado por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}! Por que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vens a mim?"

am.L: ዮሐንስ ግን እንዲህ እያለ ሊከለክለው ሞከረ፦ «እኔ በአንተ መጠመቅ ያስፈልገኛል፤ አንተስ ወደ እኔ ትመጣለህ?»
am.B: ዮሐንስ ግን ሊያግደው ሞከረ። «በአንተ መጠመቅ የሚያስፈልገኝ እኔ ነኝ» አለው፤ «ታዲያ አንተ ወደ እኔ ትመጣለህ?»
am.R: ዮሐንስ ግን ሐሳቡን ሊያስለውጠው ሞከረ። እንዲህም አለው፦ «እኔ ነኝ በአንተ መጠመቅ ያለብኝ! ለምን ወደ እኔ ትመጣለህ?»

ru.L: Иоанн же удерживал {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, говоря: «Мне нужно креститься от {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} приходишь ко мне?»
ru.B: Иоанн пытался отговорить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. «Это мне нужно креститься у {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}», — сказал он, — «а {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} приходишь ко мне?»
ru.R: Но Иоанн стал {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} отговаривать. Он сказал: «Это меня должен крестить {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}! Почему же {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} приходишь ко мне?»

hi.L: पर यूहन्ना यह कहते हुए उन्हें रोकने लगा, "मुझे तो आपसे बपतिस्मा लेने की ज़रूरत है, और आप मेरे पास आते हैं?"
hi.B: यूहन्ना ने उन्हें रोकना चाहा। "मुझे तो आपसे बपतिस्मा लेना चाहिए," उसने कहा, "और आप मेरे पास आए हैं?"
hi.R: पर यूहन्ना ने उन्हें मना करने की कोशिश की। उसने कहा, "मुझे तो आपसे बपतिस्मा लेना चाहिए! आप मेरे पास क्यों आ रहे हैं?"

uk.L: Але Іван стримував {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, кажучи: «Мені треба хреститися від {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, а {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} приходиш до мене?»
uk.B: Іван намагався зупинити {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. «Це мені треба хреститися від {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}», — сказав він, — «а {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} приходиш до мене?»
uk.R: Але Іван намагався відрадити {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. Він сказав: «Це я маю хреститися від {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}! Чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} приходиш до мене?»

ja.L: しかしヨハネは、[イエスを]思いとどまらせようとして言った。「わたしこそ、あなたから洗礼を受ける必要があるのに、あなたがわたしのところに来られるのですか？」
ja.B: ヨハネはイエスを思いとどまらせようとした。「わたしこそ、あなたから洗礼を受けるべき者です」とヨハネは言った。「それなのに、あなたがわたしのところに来られるのですか？」
ja.R: ところがヨハネは、イエスに思いとどまっていただこうとしました。ヨハネは言いました。「わたしのほうこそ、あなたから洗礼を受けなければなりません。どうして、あなたがわたしのところに来られるのですか？」

id.L: Tetapi Yohanes mencoba mencegah-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, sambil berkata, "Akulah yang perlu dibaptis oleh-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}}, dan {{deity_pronoun:engkau|Engkau}} datang kepadaku?"
id.B: Yohanes berusaha mencegah-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}. "Akulah yang perlu dibaptis oleh-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}}," katanya, "tetapi {{deity_pronoun:engkau|Engkau}} malah datang kepadaku?"
id.R: Tetapi Yohanes mencoba mencegah-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}. Dia berkata, "Seharusnya aku yang dibaptis oleh-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}}. Kenapa {{deity_pronoun:engkau|Engkau}} malah datang kepadaku?"

zh.L: 可是约翰一再拦阻{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}，说：“我需要被{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}施洗，而{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}却来到我这里？”
zh.B: 约翰想阻止{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。“我才需要受{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}的洗，”他说，“{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}怎么倒来找我呢？”
zh.R: 可是约翰想劝{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}不要这样做。他说：“应该是{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}为我施洗才对！{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}为什么来找我呢？”

fa.L: اما یحیی می‌کوشید او را بازدارد و می‌گفت: «من نیاز دارم از تو تعمید بگیرم، و تو نزد من می‌آیی؟»
fa.B: یحیی کوشید او را بازدارد. «منم که نیاز دارم از تو تعمید بگیرم،» گفت، «و با این حال تو نزد من می‌آیی؟»
fa.R: اما یحیی کوشید او را از این کار منصرف کند. گفت: «من باید از تو تعمید بگیرم! چرا تو نزد من می‌آیی؟»

decisions.choice: tried to prevent: he kept trying to stop him
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense describes an attempt, which Jesus overcomes (3:15).

decisions.choice: I ... you: John sets himself below Jesus
decisions.reason: Both pronouns are written out for emphasis. John has said he is not fit to carry the sandals of the one who comes (3:11).

decisions.choice: John speaks to Jesus in 합쇼체 with "저/제", and "선생님" for "you"
decisions.reason: People speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 (docs/korean-style.md section 4); John sets himself below Jesus (meaning decision), so he uses the humble "저". Korean needs a respectful word for "you"; "당신" would be cold or quarrelsome, and "주님" would say more than John says here, so "선생님" is used, as people address Jesus in the Korean Mark.

decisions.choice: John calls Jesus "Thầy" for "you", with no setting span, and himself "tôi"
decisions.reason: John puts himself below Jesus; "Thầy" (Teacher) is the respectful noun of address the style guide gives to those who honour him, and nouns of address take no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: tu ("por ti", "tu vens")
decisions.reason: For the whole book: anyone who speaks to Jesus uses "tu" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4), the respectful form of prayer in Brazilian churches. John's own words show how he sets himself below Jesus.

decisions.choice: "आप" from John to Jesus
decisions.reason: Everyone speaking to Jesus says "आप" in this translation; here it also shows John setting himself below him.

decisions.choice: imperfective "стримував"
decisions.reason: The Greek imperfect means he kept trying to stop Jesus without succeeding; the Ukrainian imperfective says the same, and Balanced and Readable spell it out with "намагався".

decisions.choice: John speaks to Jesus politely, with respect forms ("来られるのですか")
decisions.reason: John sets himself below Jesus (m2), so he speaks to him as to someone greater.

decisions.choice: John to Jesus: "{{deity_pronoun:engkau|Engkau}}", "-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}}" at every level; John says "aku"
decisions.reason: The style guide's address to Jesus (section 5), for the whole of Matthew; John speaks to him as a relative and a prophet, so "aku" rather than "saya".

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}" for Jesus addressed
decisions.reason: Everyone who speaks to Jesus says 你, as to God, with the deity_pronoun span (style guide section 5).

decisions.choice: John says "تو" to Jesus
decisions.reason: Address to Jesus uses تو, as in the other gospels.

alignments.target_span: 思いとどまらせようとした

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν· Ἄφες ἄρτι, οὕτως γὰρ πρέπον ἐστὶν ἡμῖν πληρῶσαι πᾶσαν δικαιοσύνην.

records.literal_gloss: Answering then the Jesus said to him, Permit now, thus for fitting it is to us to fulfill all righteousness.

en.L: But answering, Jesus said to him, "Permit [it] now, for in this way it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness."
en.B: But Jesus answered, "Allow it for now. This is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness."
en.R: Jesus answered, "Let it happen this way for now. We should do everything that is righteous in God's eyes, and this is part of it."

es.L: Pero respondiendo, Jesús le dijo: «Permite [esto] ahora, porque de esta manera nos es apropiado cumplir toda justicia».
es.B: Pero Jesús le respondió: «Acéptalo por ahora. Así es como nos corresponde cumplir toda justicia».
es.R: Jesús le respondió: «Deja que sea así por ahora. Debemos hacer todo lo que es justo a los ojos de Dios, y esto es parte de ello».

fr.L: Mais répondant, Jésus lui dit : « Laisse [faire] maintenant, car c’est ainsi qu’il nous convient d’accomplir toute justice. »
fr.B: Mais Jésus lui répondit : « Accepte pour l’instant. C’est ainsi qu’il convient que nous accomplissions toute justice. »
fr.R: Jésus lui a répondu : « Laisse faire pour le moment. Nous devons faire tout ce qui est juste aux yeux de Dieu, et cela en fait partie. »

sw.L: Lakini Yesu, akijibu, alimwambia, "Ruhusu [hili] sasa, kwa sababu kwa njia hii inafaa kwetu kutimiza haki yote."
sw.B: Lakini Yesu alijibu, "Liruhusu kwa sasa. Hii ndiyo njia inayotufaa ya kutimiza haki yote."
sw.R: Yesu alimjibu, "Acha iwe hivyo kwa sasa. Tunapaswa kufanya kila jambo lililo la haki machoni pa Mungu, na hili ni sehemu yake."

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서 대답하여 그에게 말씀하셨다. "지금은 [그렇게] 하도록 두어라. 이렇게 하여 모든 의를 이루는 것이 우리에게 마땅하기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서 대답하셨다. "지금은 그렇게 하여라. 우리가 이렇게 해서 모든 의를 이루는 것이 마땅하다."
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "지금은 이렇게 하자. 우리는 하나님께서 바라시는 의를 모두 이루어야 한다. 이 일도 그 가운데 하나다."

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu trả lời, nói với ông: "Bây giờ hãy cứ để [vậy], vì như thế là thích hợp cho chúng ta để làm trọn mọi sự công chính."
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Bây giờ hãy cứ làm như vậy, vì chúng ta nên làm trọn mọi sự công chính theo cách này."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Bây giờ cứ để như vậy đi. Chúng ta phải làm mọi điều công chính theo ý Đức Chúa Trời, và việc này là một phần trong đó."

pt.L: Mas, respondendo, Jesus lhe disse: "Permita [isso] agora, pois assim nos convém cumprir toda a justiça."
pt.B: Mas Jesus respondeu: "Deixe que seja assim por enquanto. É deste modo que convém cumprirmos toda a justiça."
pt.R: Jesus respondeu: "Deixe acontecer assim por enquanto. Nós devemos fazer tudo o que é justo aos olhos de Deus, e isto faz parte."

am.L: ኢየሱስ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አለው፦ «ለአሁኑ ፍቀድ፤ በዚህ መንገድ ጽድቅን ሁሉ መፈጸም ለእኛ ተገቢ ነውና።»
am.B: ኢየሱስ ግን እንዲህ ሲል መለሰለት፦ «ለጊዜው ይሁን፤ ጽድቅን ሁሉ ለመፈጸም ለእኛ ተገቢው መንገድ ይህ ነው።»
am.R: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት፦ «ለአሁኑ እንዲህ ይሁን። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትክክል የሆነውን ሁሉ ማድረግ ይገባናል፤ ይህም የዚያ አንዱ ክፍል ነው።»

ru.L: Отвечая же, Иисус сказал ему: «Позволь сейчас, ведь так подобает нам исполнить всякую праведность.»
ru.B: Но Иисус ответил: «Позволь это сейчас. Так нам подобает исполнить всё, чего требует праведность.»
ru.R: Иисус ответил: «Пусть сейчас будет так. Мы должны делать всё, что правильно в глазах Бога, и это — часть того.»

hi.L: पर यीशु ने उत्तर देकर उससे कहा, "अभी [ऐसा] होने दो, क्योंकि हमें इसी रीति से सारी धार्मिकता को पूरा करना उचित है।"
hi.B: पर यीशु ने उत्तर दिया, "अभी ऐसा ही होने दो। हमारे लिए सारी धार्मिकता को पूरा करने का यही उचित तरीक़ा है।"
hi.R: यीशु ने उत्तर दिया, "अभी ऐसा ही होने दो। हमें वह सब करना चाहिए जो परमेश्वर की नज़र में सही है, और यह भी उसी का हिस्सा है।"

uk.L: А Ісус у відповідь сказав йому: «Дозволь тепер, бо так личить нам виконати всю праведність.»
uk.B: Але Ісус відповів: «Дозволь це тепер. Так належить нам виконати всю праведність.»
uk.R: Ісус відповів: «Нехай поки що буде так. Ми маємо робити все, що Бог вважає праведним, і це теж частина того.»

ja.L: しかしイエスは答えて、彼に言われた。「今はそうさせなさい。このようにして、すべての義を満たすことは、わたしたちにふさわしいからである。」
ja.B: しかしイエスはお答えになった。「今は、そうさせなさい。このようにして、すべての義を満たすのが、わたしたちにふさわしいことなのだ。」
ja.R: イエスはお答えになりました。「今は、このとおりにしなさい。神の前に正しいことを、すべて行うのが、わたしたちにふさわしい。これもその一つなのだ。」

id.L: Tetapi Yesus menjawab dan berkata kepadanya, "Biarkanlah [hal itu] sekarang, sebab dengan cara demikian layaklah bagi kita untuk menggenapi seluruh kebenaran."
id.B: Tetapi Yesus menjawab, "Biarkanlah hal itu untuk sekarang. Inilah cara yang layak bagi kita untuk menggenapi seluruh kebenaran."
id.R: Tetapi Yesus menjawab, "Biarkan saja terjadi sekarang. Memang sepatutnya kita melakukan semua yang Allah anggap benar."

zh.L: 耶稣却回答他说：“现在就容许吧，因为这样完成一切的义，对我们是合宜的。”
zh.B: 耶稣回答：“暂时就这样吧。我们这样做，来成就一切的义，是合宜的。”
zh.R: 耶稣回答：“现在就这样做吧。我们应当做{{god_term:神|上帝}}看为正确的一切事，这也是其中的一部分。”

fa.L: اما عیسی در پاسخ به او گفت: «اکنون بگذار، زیرا ما را چنین شایسته است که همهٔ پارسایی را به جا آوریم.»
fa.B: اما عیسی پاسخ داد: «اکنون بگذار چنین شود. شایسته است که ما بدین‌سان همهٔ پارسایی را به جا آوریم.»
fa.R: عیسی پاسخ داد: «اکنون بگذار این‌گونه شود. ما باید هر کاری را که در نظر خدا درست است انجام دهیم، و این بخشی از آن است.»

decisions.choice: fulfill all righteousness: do all that God wills and requires
alternatives: carry out God's plan to save his people
keep every rule of the law
decisions.reason: In Matthew righteousness is doing God's will (5:6, 10, 20; 6:33). Jesus, though greater than John, takes his place with the people who come in obedience to God's call. Some see a wider sense: completing God's saving purpose.

decisions.choice: us: Jesus and John together
decisions.reason: Both have a part: John in baptizing and Jesus in being baptized.

decisions.choice: now: for the present
decisions.reason: The word says the order John expected is set aside for the time being.

decisions.choice: do everything that is righteous in God's eyes
decisions.reason: "Fulfill righteousness" is not plain English. Readable keeps the key word and says whose standard is meant.

decisions.choice: "의" at every level; Readable adds "하나님께서 바라시는"
decisions.reason: "의" is a key term and keeps the same word at every level (docs/korean-style.md section 6); Readable explains it with what God wants, as the meaning decision describes (all that God wills and requires).

decisions.choice: "làm trọn mọi sự công chính" (L, B); "làm mọi điều công chính theo ý Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: "Công chính" is the key term for righteousness; Readable adds "theo ý Đức Chúa Trời" from the meaning decision (all that God wills).

decisions.choice: você ("Permita", "Deixe")
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to John, a person, so he uses "você", as everywhere in this translation; "tu" is only for speech to God and to Jesus.

decisions.choice: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትክክል የሆነውን ሁሉ (all that is right in God's sight, R); ጽድቅን ሁሉ (L, B)
decisions.reason: "ጽድቅ" is the key word for righteousness and stays at Literal and Balanced. Here it means doing what God wills, so Readable says that, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "धार्मिकता" (L, B); "जो परमेश्वर की नज़र में सही है" (R)
decisions.reason: "धार्मिकता" is the book's key term; Readable says what it means here, doing what God wills.

decisions.choice: "तुम" form "होने दो" from Jesus to John
decisions.reason: Jesus says "तुम" to those he speaks to, throughout the book.

decisions.choice: 'праведность' (L, B); 'всё, что правильно в глазах Бога' (R)
decisions.reason: 'Праведность' is the key term for doing what God requires. Readable says it in plain words, since the sense here is conduct.

decisions.choice: "すべての義を満たす" (L, B); "神の前に正しいことを、すべて行う" (R)
alternatives: "すべての正しいことを行う" (B)
decisions.reason: Righteousness in Matthew is doing God's will (m1). "義" is the key term at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what it means, as the Japanese brief allows. "満たす" keeps the verb that the fulfilment formula renders "実現する", in a form that fits righteousness.

decisions.choice: Jesus speaks plainly ("そうさせなさい"); the narrator says "言われた", "お答えになった"
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks with quiet authority in the plain style at every level, and the narrator uses respect forms for him, as through the book.

decisions.choice: "kebenaran" (L, B); "semua yang Allah anggap benar" (R); "kita"
decisions.reason: "kebenaran" is the key term for righteousness; Readable says what it means here, as the style guide allows. "us" is Jesus and John, and the two are speaking together, so "kita" (inclusive).

decisions.choice: "menjawab dan berkata" (L); "menjawab" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The recurring formula for "answered and said" (style guide section 12a), for the whole of Matthew.

decisions.choice: "一切的义" (L, B); "{{god_term:神|上帝}}看为正确的一切事" (R)
decisions.reason: "义" is the key term for righteousness through Matthew; Readable says whose standard is meant, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "پارسایی" (Literal, Balanced); "هر کاری که در نظر خدا درست است" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Righteousness, as the brief chose.

es.R: Así que Juan aceptó bautizar a Jesús.

fr.B: Alors Jean {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} laissa se faire baptiser.
fr.R: Alors Jean a accepté de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} baptiser.

ko.B: 그러자 요한은 예수께서 세례를 받으시도록 했다.

vi.B: Bấy giờ Giăng chịu làm báp-têm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vậy Giăng đồng ý làm báp-têm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.B: Então João deixou que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fosse batizado.

hi.L: तब वह उन्हें होने देता है।
hi.B: तब यूहन्ना ने उन्हें बपतिस्मा लेने दिया।
hi.R: तब यूहन्ना उन्हें बपतिस्मा देने को मान गया।

ja.L: そこで、彼は[イエスに]そうさせる。
ja.B: そこでヨハネは、イエスの言われるとおりに洗礼を授けた。
ja.R: それでヨハネは、イエスに洗礼を授けることにしました。

zh.B: 于是约翰就让{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}受洗了。
zh.R: 约翰就答应为{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}施洗。

fa.B: آن‌گاه یحیی گذاشت که او تعمید یابد.
fa.R: پس یحیی پذیرفت که او را تعمید دهد.

decisions.choice: permits him: allows him to be baptized
decisions.reason: The verb is the one Jesus used: "permit it". John gives way.

decisions.choice: let him be baptized (B); agreed to baptize him (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what John permitted.

decisions.choice: a Jesús
decisions.reason: The pronoun joined to the infinitive ("bautizarlo") could not carry the deity_pronoun setting, and the name is clearer for new readers; the sense is the same as the English "baptize him".

decisions.choice: "そうさせる", the same verb as Jesus's "そうさせなさい" (L)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one Jesus used (m1), so Literal repeats his word, in the Greek present tense. "許す" could be read as "forgive".

source.text: βαπτισθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εὐθὺς ἀνέβη ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἠνεῴχθησαν οἱ οὐρανοί, καὶ εἶδεν πνεῦμα θεοῦ καταβαῖνον ὡσεὶ περιστερὰν ἐρχόμενον ἐπ’ αὐτόν·

records.literal_gloss: Having been baptized then the Jesus immediately went up from the water; and behold, were opened the heavens, and he saw Spirit of God descending as a dove coming upon him;

en.L: And when Jesus had been baptized, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} immediately went up from the water, and look, the heavens were opened, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw [the] Spirit of God descending like a dove, coming upon {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Jesus was baptized, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came straight up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens opened, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the Spirit of God coming down like a dove and settling on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: After Jesus was baptized, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came up out of the water right away. Then heaven opened, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the Spirit of God coming down on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} like a dove.

es.L: Y habiendo sido bautizado, Jesús subió en seguida del agua; y mira, se abrieron los cielos, y vio [al] Espíritu de Dios descender como una paloma, viniendo sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Jesús fue bautizado y salió enseguida del agua. De pronto se abrieron los cielos, y vio al Espíritu de Dios que bajaba como una paloma y se posaba sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Después de ser bautizado, Jesús salió enseguida del agua. Entonces se abrió el cielo, y vio al Espíritu de Dios que bajaba sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} como una paloma.

fr.L: Et ayant été baptisé, Jésus remonta aussitôt de l’eau ; et voici, les cieux furent ouverts, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit l’Esprit de Dieu descendre comme une colombe, venant sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Dès qu’il eut été baptisé, Jésus sortit de l’eau. Soudain les cieux s’ouvrirent, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit l’Esprit de Dieu descendre comme une colombe et se poser sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Après avoir été baptisé, Jésus est tout de suite sorti de l’eau. Alors le ciel s’est ouvert, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vu l’Esprit de Dieu descendre sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme une colombe.

sw.L: Na Yesu, baada ya kubatizwa, mara moja alitoka majini; na tazama, mbingu zilifunguliwa, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} aliona Roho wa Mungu akishuka mfano wa njiwa, akija juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Yesu alipobatizwa, alitoka majini mara moja. Ghafula mbingu zikafunguka, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akamwona Roho wa Mungu akishuka kama njiwa na kutua juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Baada ya Yesu kubatizwa, alitoka majini mara moja. Kisha mbingu zikafunguka, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akamwona Roho wa Mungu akishuka juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama njiwa.

ko.L: 예수께서 세례를 받으시고 곧 물에서 올라오셨다. 그리고 보라, 하늘들이 열렸고, 그분은 하나님의 영이 비둘기처럼 내려와 자기 위에 오시는 것을 보셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서 세례를 받으시고 곧바로 물에서 올라오셨다. 그때 하늘이 열리고, 예수께서는 하나님의 영이 비둘기처럼 내려와 자신 위에 머무르시는 것을 보셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 세례를 받으시고 바로 물에서 올라오셨다. 그때 하늘이 열렸다. 예수께서는 하나님의 영이 비둘기처럼 자신에게 내려오시는 것을 보셨다.

vi.L: Và sau khi chịu báp-têm, Đức Giê-xu lập tức lên khỏi nước; và kìa, các tầng trời mở ra, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời giáng xuống như chim bồ câu, đến trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chịu báp-têm xong, Đức Giê-xu liền lên khỏi nước. Bỗng các tầng trời mở ra, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời giáng xuống như chim bồ câu và đậu trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Sau khi chịu báp-têm, Đức Giê-xu liền từ dưới nước đi lên. Lúc ấy, bầu trời mở ra, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời ngự xuống trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như một con chim bồ câu.

pt.L: E, tendo sido batizado, Jesus logo subiu da água; e eis que os céus se abriram, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} viu o Espírito de Deus descendo como uma pomba [e] vindo sobre {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.B: Assim que foi batizado, Jesus saiu da água. De repente, os céus se abriram, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} viu o Espírito de Deus descer como uma pomba e pousar sobre {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.R: Depois que foi batizado, Jesus logo saiu da água. Então o céu se abriu, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} viu o Espírito de Deus descer sobre {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} como uma pomba.

am.L: ኢየሱስም ከተጠመቀ በኋላ ወዲያውኑ ከውኃው ወጣ፤ እነሆም፣ ሰማያት ተከፈቱ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ እየወረደ ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አየ።
am.B: ኢየሱስ ተጠምቆ ወዲያውኑ ከውኃው ወጣ። ድንገትም ሰማይ ተከፈተ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ ወርዶ በእርሱ ላይ ሲያርፍ አየ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ከተጠመቀ በኋላ ወዲያውኑ ከውኃው ወጣ። በዚያን ጊዜ ሰማይ ተከፈተ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ ሆኖ በእርሱ ላይ ሲወርድ አየ።

ru.L: Крестившись же, Иисус тотчас вышел из воды, и вот, открылись небеса, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} увидел Духа Божьего, сходящего, как голубь, [и] нисходящего на {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.
ru.B: Иисус крестился и сразу вышел из воды. Вдруг небеса раскрылись, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} увидел, как Дух Божий спускается, словно голубь, и опускается на {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.
ru.R: Когда Иисус крестился, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сразу вышел из воды. И тут открылось небо, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} увидел, как Дух Божий спускается на {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}, словно голубь.

hi.L: और बपतिस्मा लेकर यीशु तुरंत पानी से ऊपर आए, और देखो, आकाश खुल गया, और उन्होंने परमेश्वर के आत्मा को कबूतर के समान उतरते और अपने ऊपर आते देखा।
hi.B: बपतिस्मा लेकर यीशु तुरंत पानी से ऊपर आए। उसी क्षण आकाश खुल गया, और उन्होंने परमेश्वर के आत्मा को कबूतर की तरह उतरते और अपने ऊपर ठहरते देखा।
hi.R: बपतिस्मा लेने के बाद यीशु तुरंत पानी से बाहर आए। तब आकाश खुल गया, और उन्होंने देखा कि परमेश्वर का आत्मा कबूतर की तरह उन पर उतर रहा है।

uk.L: А охрестившись, Ісус зараз же вийшов з води; і ось відкрилися небеса, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} побачив Духа Божого, що сходив, як голуб, і спускався на {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}.
uk.B: Ісус охрестився і відразу вийшов з води. І раптом небеса відкрилися, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} побачив Духа Божого, який спускався, наче голуб, і зупинився на {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}}.
uk.R: Після того як Ісуса охрестили, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} одразу вийшов з води. Тоді небо відкрилося, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} побачив, як Дух Божий сходить на {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, наче голуб.

ja.L: イエスは洗礼を受けると、すぐに水から上がられた。すると、なんと、天が開かれ、イエスは神の霊が鳩のように降って、ご自分の上に来るのをご覧になった。
ja.B: イエスは洗礼を受けると、すぐに水から上がられた。すると天が開け、イエスは、神の霊が鳩のように降って来て、ご自分の上にとどまるのをご覧になった。
ja.R: イエスは洗礼を受けると、すぐに水から上がられました。すると、天が開きました。そしてイエスは、神の霊が鳩のようにご自分の上に降って来るのをご覧になりました。

id.L: Dan setelah Yesus dibaptis, {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} segera keluar dari air, dan lihatlah, langit terbuka, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} melihat Roh Allah turun seperti burung merpati dan datang ke atas-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.
id.B: Sesudah dibaptis, Yesus langsung keluar dari air. Tiba-tiba langit terbuka, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} melihat Roh Allah turun seperti burung merpati dan hinggap di atas-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.
id.R: Sesudah dibaptis, Yesus langsung keluar dari air. Tiba-tiba langit terbuka, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} melihat Roh Allah turun seperti burung merpati dan hinggap di atas-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.

zh.L: 耶稣受洗以后，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}立即从水中上来；看哪，天开了，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}看见{{god_term:神|上帝}}的灵如同鸽子般降下，来到{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}身上。
zh.B: 耶稣受了洗，马上从水里起来。忽然，天开了，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}看见{{god_term:神|上帝}}的灵像一只鸽子那样下来，停在{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}身上。
zh.R: 耶稣受洗以后，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}马上从水里上来。这时天开了，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}看见{{god_term:神|上帝}}的灵像鸽子一样降到{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}身上。

fa.L: و عیسی چون تعمید یافت، بی‌درنگ از آب بالا آمد، و اینک، آسمان‌ها گشوده شد، و روح خدا را دید که همچون کبوتری فرود می‌آید و بر او می‌آید.
fa.B: عیسی تعمید یافت و بی‌درنگ از آب بالا آمد. ناگهان آسمان‌ها گشوده شد، و روح خدا را دید که همچون کبوتری فرود می‌آید و بر او قرار می‌گیرد.
fa.R: پس از آن که عیسی تعمید یافت، بی‌درنگ از آب بیرون آمد. آن‌گاه آسمان باز شد، و دید که روح خدا مانند کبوتری بر او فرود می‌آید.

decisions.choice: the heavens were opened: God shows himself and speaks
decisions.reason: When heaven opens in Scripture, God is giving a vision or coming to help (Ezekiel 1:1; Isaiah 64:1).

decisions.choice: like a dove: the Spirit's coming is compared to a dove
alternatives: the Spirit took the bodily form of a dove (Luke 3:22)
decisions.reason: Matthew says only that the Spirit came down like a dove; it may describe the Spirit's form or the way it came down. Luke says "in bodily form".

decisions.choice: the Spirit upon him: God's Spirit resting on his chosen one
decisions.reason: Isaiah promised that God's Spirit would rest on the branch from Jesse (Isaiah 11:2) and on God's servant (Isaiah 42:1). Matthew quotes the second passage of Jesus in 12:18.

decisions.choice: the heavens were opened, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: the heavens were opened to him, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "to him". The SBLGNT leaves it out. Either way Jesus is the one who sees. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: look (L); suddenly (B); then (R) (B, R)
decisions.reason: Matthew uses this word to point to what comes next. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal uses "look", and Balanced and Readable carry its force in the flow of the sentence, as in 1:20.

decisions.choice: mira (L); de pronto (B); entonces (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20 and the English: "he aquí" is archaic. Literal keeps the word with "mira"; Balanced and Readable carry it with a time word, as the English does. The same in 3:17.

decisions.choice: tazama (L); ghafula (B); kisha (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20: Literal keeps the word that draws attention; Balanced and Readable carry it with a time word, as the English does ("suddenly", "then"). The same in 3:17.

decisions.choice: "곧" (L), "곧바로" (B), "바로" (R) for "immediately"; "하나님의 영" with the honorific
decisions.reason: The words for "immediately" used through the Korean Mark. The Spirit of God takes the honorific ("내려오시는"), as the Holy Spirit does in Mark 1:10.

decisions.choice: "lập tức" (L); "liền" (B, R) for "immediately"
decisions.reason: The word settled for Literal in the Gospels, as in Mark; Balanced and Readable use the shorter "liền". The same in 4:20 and 4:22.

decisions.choice: "các tầng trời" (L, B); "bầu trời" (R) for the heavens
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:10: the plural keeps the Greek "heavens", which opened to show God at work; Readable says the sky.

decisions.choice: ሰማያት (the heavens, L); ሰማይ (heaven, B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has the plural, which Literal keeps. In ordinary Amharic the sky and heaven are one "ሰማይ", so Balanced and Readable use the singular, as in 3:17.

decisions.choice: "आकाश"
decisions.reason: The opened heavens are seen above, so Hindi says "आकाश", the sky; the voice of 3:17 is "स्वर्ग" from where God speaks.

decisions.choice: "آسمان‌ها" (Literal, Balanced); "آسمان" (Readable)
decisions.reason: One word serves for sky and heaven; Readable uses the singular as in Mark 1:10.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν λέγουσα· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα.

records.literal_gloss: And behold, a voice out of the heavens saying, This is the son of me the beloved, in whom I was well pleased.

en.L: And look, a voice out of the heavens, saying, "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son, the beloved, in whom I am well pleased."
en.B: And a voice spoke from heaven: "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} dearly loved Son, and I delight in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: Then a voice from heaven said, "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son, and I love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. I am very pleased with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: Y mira, una voz desde los cielos que decía: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo, el amado, en quien me complazco».
es.B: Y una voz habló desde el cielo: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo muy amado; en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me deleito».
es.R: Entonces una voz desde el cielo dijo: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo, y yo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} amo. Estoy muy contento con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».

fr.L: Et voici, une voix [venant] des cieux, disant : « Celui-ci est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils, le bien-aimé, en qui je prends plaisir. »
fr.B: Et une voix se fit entendre du ciel : « Celui-ci est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils bien-aimé ; en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} je trouve {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} joie. »
fr.R: Puis une voix venant du ciel a dit : « Voici {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils, et je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aime. Je suis très content de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »

sw.L: Na tazama, sauti kutoka mbinguni, ikisema, "Huyu ndiye Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, yule mpendwa, ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} nimefurahishwa."
sw.B: Na sauti ilinena kutoka mbinguni: "Huyu ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mpendwa sana; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ananifurahisha."
sw.R: Kisha sauti kutoka mbinguni ikasema, "Huyu ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nami ninampenda. Ninapendezwa sana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}."

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 하늘들에서 소리가 [나서] 말하였다. "이는 내 아들, 사랑하는 [아들]이다. 내가 그를 기뻐한다."
ko.B: 그리고 하늘에서 이렇게 말하는 소리가 들렸다. "이는 내가 사랑하는 아들이다. 나는 그를 기뻐한다."
ko.R: 그때 하늘에서 소리가 들렸다. "이는 내 아들이다. 나는 그를 사랑한다. 나는 그를 무척 기뻐한다."

vi.L: Và kìa, có tiếng từ các tầng trời phán rằng: "Đây là Con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, [Con] yêu dấu, Đấng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} rất đẹp lòng."
vi.B: Và có tiếng từ trời phán: "Đây là Con yêu dấu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta rất vui lòng về Con ấy."
vi.R: Rồi có tiếng từ trời phán: "Đây là Con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} yêu thương Con ấy. Ta rất hài lòng về Con ấy."

pt.L: E eis [que veio] uma voz dos céus, dizendo: "Este é o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho, o amado, em quem eu tenho prazer."
pt.B: E uma voz do céu disse: "Este é o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho amado, que me dá grande alegria."
pt.R: Então uma voz do céu disse: "Este é o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho, e eu {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} amo. Estou muito contente com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}."

am.L: እነሆም፣ ከሰማያት እንዲህ የሚል ድምፅ [መጣ]፦ «ይህ ልጄ፣ የምወደው ነው፤ በእርሱም ደስ ተሰኘሁ።»
am.B: ከሰማይም እንዲህ የሚል ድምፅ ተሰማ፦ «እጅግ የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው፤ በእርሱም ደስ ይለኛል።»
am.R: ከዚያም ከሰማይ አንድ ድምፅ እንዲህ አለ፦ «ይህ ልጄ ነው፤ እወደዋለሁ። በእርሱም እጅግ ደስ ብሎኛል።»

ru.L: И вот, голос с небес, говорящий: «Это {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Сын, возлюбленный, к которому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} благоволю.»
ru.B: И голос с небес сказал: «Это {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} любимый Сын, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} радуюсь о {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}}.»
ru.R: Тогда голос с неба сказал: «Это {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Сын, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} люблю {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. Я очень доволен {{deity_pronoun:им|Им}}.»

hi.L: और देखो, स्वर्ग से एक आवाज़, यह कहते हुए, "यह मेरा पुत्र है, वह प्रिय, जिसमें मुझे प्रसन्नता है।"
hi.B: और स्वर्ग से एक आवाज़ आई: "यह मेरा प्यारा पुत्र है; मैं इससे बहुत प्रसन्न हूँ।"
hi.R: तब स्वर्ग से एक आवाज़ ने कहा, "यह मेरा पुत्र है, और मैं इससे प्रेम करता हूँ। मैं इससे बहुत ख़ुश हूँ।"

uk.L: І ось голос з небес, що каже: «Це {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Син, улюблений, у якому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} маю вподобання.»
uk.B: І голос з небес промовив: «Це {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} улюблений Син, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} тішуся {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.»
uk.R: Тоді голос з неба сказав: «Це {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Син, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} люблю {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. Я дуже задоволений {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.»

ja.L: すると、なんと、天から声があって、こう言った。「これはわたしの子、愛する者である。わたしはこの者を喜んでいる。」
ja.B: そして、天から声がした。「これはわたしの愛する子である。わたしはこの子を深く喜んでいる。」
ja.R: すると、天から声が聞こえました。「これはわたしの子だ。わたしはこの子を愛している。この子のことを、とても喜んでいる。」

id.L: Dan lihatlah, suatu suara dari surga berkata, "Inilah Anak-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, yang terkasih, kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}lah {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} berkenan."
id.B: Lalu terdengarlah suara dari surga: "Inilah Anak-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} yang sangat {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} kasihi, dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} berkenan kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}."
id.R: Lalu terdengar suara dari surga, "Inilah Anak-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} yang sangat {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} kasihi. Aku senang sekali kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}."

zh.L: 看哪，从天上有声音说：“这是我的儿子，那蒙爱的；我以{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}为喜悦。”
zh.B: 又有声音从天上说：“这是我深爱的儿子，我非常喜爱{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。”
zh.R: 接着，有声音从天上说：“这是我的儿子，我爱{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。我对{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}非常满意。”

fa.L: و اینک، صدایی از آسمان‌ها که می‌گوید: «این است پسر من، آن محبوب، که از او خشنودم.»
fa.B: و صدایی از آسمان گفت: «این پسر عزیز من است، و از او بسیار خشنودم.»
fa.R: آن‌گاه صدایی از آسمان گفت: «این پسر من است، و من او را دوست دارم. از او بسیار خشنودم.»

decisions.choice: my Son ... in whom I am well pleased: Psalm 2:7 and Isaiah 42:1
decisions.reason: In Psalm 2:7 God says to his anointed king, "You are my son." In Isaiah 42:1 God speaks of his servant, "in whom my soul delights", on whom he puts his Spirit (3:16). The voice calls Jesus both the king and the servant. "Beloved" may also recall Abraham's beloved son Isaac (Genesis 22:2).

decisions.choice: I am well pleased: a settled delight
alternatives: I was pleased at one moment in the past
decisions.reason: The past tense expresses God's delight as decided and complete, not limited to one moment.

decisions.choice: This is: the voice speaks about Jesus to those present
decisions.reason: Mark 1:11 and Luke 3:22 have "You are". In Matthew the voice announces who Jesus is, as at the transfiguration (17:5).

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: Matthew uses this word to point to what comes next. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal uses "look", and Balanced and Readable carry its force in the flow of the sentence, as in 1:20.

decisions.choice: Son with a capital letter
decisions.reason: When God calls Jesus his Son, the word is a title, written with a capital letter as in John. In 2:15 the quotation from Hosea keeps the lower case, since there it first spoke of Israel.

decisions.choice: God speaks of his Son in 해라체 with "그를", worded as the Korean Mark 1:11 apart from "이는"
decisions.reason: As a father speaks of his son, God does not use the honorific of the Son; Matthew has "This is" where Mark has "You are", and the Korean changes only that.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" for himself (with the setting) and "Con ấy" (that Son) for "him"; the verb is "phán"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 9:7: "Con" is a noun, capitalised, and takes no setting span; Vietnamese would not have God call his Son "Ngài". In Matthew the voice speaks about Jesus, not to him as in Mark 1:11.

decisions.choice: "यह", "इससे" in the Father's words
decisions.reason: The Father speaks of his own Son, and a father does not use the honorific of his son in Hindi.

decisions.choice: 'к которому я благоволю'
decisions.reason: Modern Russian says 'благоволить к кому-то'. Literal keeps the verb of settled delight without the Synodal noun phrase.

decisions.choice: "これはわたしの子、愛する者である。わたしはこの者を喜んでいる" (L); "これはわたしの愛する子である。わたしはこの子を深く喜んでいる" (B); "これはわたしの子だ。わたしはこの子を愛している。この子のことを、とても喜んでいる" (R); the same words in 17:5
decisions.reason: In Matthew the voice speaks about Jesus to those present (m3), so Japanese says "これは", not Mark's "あなたは". The past tense states a settled delight (m2), which "〜ている" expresses. God's voice speaks plainly. The voice at the transfiguration (17:5) repeats these words, so each level uses the same Japanese there.

decisions.choice: God says "Aku" plainly after a noun or pronoun inside a clause; "-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}" and "-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}" with spans
decisions.reason: "Aku" in "yang Aku kasihi" and "Aku berkenan" stands where English would write "I", always capitalised; the possessive and object forms take spans.

decisions.choice: "我的儿子" with no span; "{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}" for the Son
decisions.reason: The English spans "My" when God speaks; Chinese has no reverent first person, so "我" takes no span. Literal adds a span on "他" where the English Literal has "in whom", since Chinese needs the pronoun.

decisions.choice: "این", "از او" in the Father's words, otherwise as Mark 1:11
decisions.reason: Matthew has this is, spoken about Jesus.
